def register_combat_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "🔎 Полювання")
    def hunt(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        from systems.travel_system import is_user_travelling
        if is_user_travelling(user_id):
            from keyboards import map_kb
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "🚶 Полювання недоступне під час подорожі.\n\n"
                    "Відкрий мапу, щоб оновити час у дорозі "
                    "або скасувати маршрут."
                ),
                reply_markup=map_kb(),
            )
            return
        if not _combat_message_allowed_11_3_1(message):
            return

        current_location = get_current_location(user_id)
        if current_location == "city":
            from keyboards import city_kb
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "🏙️ У Місті не можна полювати. Відкрий 🗺️ Мапу та вирушай у доступну локацію.",
                reply_markup=city_kb(),
            )
            return

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)


        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Спочатку натисни /start",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        current_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
        max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

        hp_percent = 0

        if max_hp > 0:
            hp_percent = (current_hp / max_hp) * 100

        if hp_percent <= 25:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "😴 Ви занадто слабкі для полювання.\n\n"
                    f"❤️ Здоров’я: {current_hp}/{max_hp} ({hp_percent:.1f}%)\n"
                    "Ваше здоров’я нижче або дорівнює 25%.\n\n"
                    "Відпочиньте або використайте зілля!"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        location_id = get_current_location(user_id)
        location = LOCATIONS.get(location_id, LOCATIONS["start_path"])
        location_max_level = int(location.get("level_max", lvl))

        if lvl > location_max_level:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    f"🌿 Ця місцевість більше не становить для тебе виклику.\n\n"
                    f"📍 Локація: {location['name']}\n"
                    f"🏷 Рівні локації: {location.get('level_min', 1)}–{location_max_level}\n"
                    f"👤 Твій рівень: {lvl}\n\n"
                    f"Ти занадто сильний для полювання тут.\n"
                    f"Відкрий 🗺️ Мапу та перейди до складнішої локації."
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        energy_result = consume_energy_for_hunt(user_id)

        if not energy_result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                energy_result["message"],
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = generate_mob(player_level=lvl, location_id=location_id)
        mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]
        mob["potion_cooldown"] = 0
        mob["stunned_turns"] = 0
        mob["skill_cooldowns"] = {}
        mob["enemy_effects"] = {}
        mob["player_effects"] = {}
        mob["last_skill_spent_rage"] = 0
        mob["last_skill_spent_combo"] = 0
        mob["player_hp"] = current_hp
        mob["player_max_hp"] = max_hp

        init_class_combat_resource(user_id, mob)
        init_combat_effects(mob)

        bot.user_data = getattr(bot, "user_data", {})
        encounter = begin_pve_encounter(user_id, message.chat.id, mob)
        mob["pve_encounter_id"] = encounter["encounter_id"]
        mob["pve_started_at"] = encounter["started_at"]
        mob["pve_deadline_at"] = encounter["deadline_at"]
        bot.user_data[user_id] = mob

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        attack_type_text = "Фізична" if mob["attack_type"] == "physical" else "Магічна"
        player_attack_type_text = "Фізична" if attack_profile["attack_type"] == "physical" else "Магічна"

        elite_text = ""

        if mob.get("is_boss"):
            elite_text = (
                "👑 БОС ЛОКАЦІЇ!\n"
                "⚠️ Надзвичайно небезпечний ворог із унікальними навичками та фазою Люті.\n\n"
            )
        elif mob.get("is_elite"):
            elite_text = (
                "⭐ ЕЛІТНИЙ ВОРОГ!\n"
                "Ця істота значно сильніша за звичайну.\n\n"
            )

        weapon_text = attack_profile.get("weapon_text") or "Без зброї"
        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"

        text = (
            f"📍 Мапа: {location['name']}\n"
            f"🔎 Ти зустрів {mob['name']}\n\n"
            f"{elite_text}"
            f"======================\n\n"

            f"👤 {character_name}\n"
            f"❤️ Здоров’я: {current_hp}/{max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(current_hp, max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}"
            f"⚔️ Тип атаки: {player_attack_type_text}\n"
            f"🗡️ Зброя: {weapon_text}\n"
            f"💥 Атака: {attack_profile['display_attack']}\n"
            f"🛡 Фіз. захист: {player_pdef}\n"
            f"🔮 Маг. захист: {player_mdef}\n\n"

            f"----------------------\n\n"

            f"👹 {mob['name']}\n"
            f"🏷 Рівень: {mob['level']}\n"
            f"❤️ Здоров’я: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}\n"
            f"⚔️ Атака: {mob['attack']}\n"
            f"🛡 Фіз. захист: {mob.get('pdef', mob.get('def', 0))}\n"
            f"🔮 Маг. захист: {mob.get('mdef', mob.get('def', 0))}\n"
            f"🎯 Тип атаки: {attack_type_text}\n\n"

            f"⚔️ Бій починається!"
        )

        # Спочатку показуємо фальшиву клавіатуру, щоб системна не з'являлася
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "⚔️ Бій розпочався!",
            reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb()
        )
        # Потім показуємо повідомлення про бій з inline меню
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "⚔️ Бій триває...")
    def combat_placeholder(message):
        # Обробник для фальшивої кнопки — нічого не робимо, просто відповідаємо
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
            mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "Використовуй інлайн кнопки для бою!",
                reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb()
            )
        else:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "Ти не в бою!",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "⚔️ Атакувати")
    def attack(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Спочатку почни полювання",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"

        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        player_effects_text += _apply_boss_dot_at_player_turn_15_5_0(mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Персонажа не знайдено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        # Використовуємо здоров'я з mob, якщо воно там є, інакше з бази (на випадок старих сесій)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]

        mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(
            mob,
            attack_profile["attack_type"]
        )

        normal_attack_uses_hit_roll = attack_profile["attack_type"] == "physical"

        if normal_attack_uses_hit_roll:
            player_hit_result = roll_player_normal_attack_hit(
                player_dex=dex_,
                mob_dex=mob.get("dex", 0),
            )
            player_attack_hit = bool(player_hit_result["hit"])
        else:
            player_hit_result = None
            player_attack_hit = True

        if player_attack_hit:
            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=attack_profile["stat_attack"],
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=attack_profile["attack_type"],
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"],
                weapon_subtype=attack_profile.get("weapon_subtype", ""),
            )
            dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)
        else:
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0

        mob["hp"] -= dmg

        resource_attack_text = add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = enemy_effect_text

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""

        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1
            enemy_action_text = f"💫 {mob['name']} оглушений і пропускає хід.\n\n"
        else:
            mob_attack_result = _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob=mob,
                player_pdef=player_pdef,
                player_mdef=player_mdef,
                player_dex=dex_,
                sta=sta_,
                level=lvl,
            )

            mob_dmg = mob_attack_result["damage"]
            is_mob_crit = mob_attack_result["is_crit"]
            is_dodge = mob_attack_result["is_dodge"]

            shield_text = ""

            if not is_dodge and mob_dmg > 0:
                mob_dmg, shield_text = apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, mob_dmg)
            boss_action_text = _finalize_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob, mob_attack_result, mob_dmg
            )

            player_hp -= mob_dmg
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp

            resource_damage_text = add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, mob_dmg)

            if is_dodge:
                enemy_action_text = f"💨 УХИЛ! {character_name} уникнув атаки {mob['name']}\n\n"
            elif is_mob_crit:
                enemy_action_text = f"💥 КРИТ {mob['name']}! {character_name} отримав {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
            else:
                enemy_action_text = f"👹 {mob['name']} завдав {character_name} {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"

        if mob.get("is_boss") and 'boss_action_text' in locals() and boss_action_text:
            enemy_action_text = boss_action_text

        if player_hp <= 0:
            durability_damage = damage_equipped_items_on_death(
                user_id=user_id
            )

            set_current_hp(user_id, 1)
            try:
                from db import reset_hp_regen_timers_now
                reset_hp_regen_timers_now(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

            mp_restore_result = apply_post_combat_mp_floor_17_15_1(user_id)

            if user_id in bot.user_data:
                del bot.user_data[user_id]

            text = build_lethal_combat_log(
                turn_context=locals(),
                player_hp=player_hp,
                player_max_hp=player_max_hp,
                durability_damage=durability_damage,
            )
            text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            mob["potion_cooldown"] -= 1

        text = "⚔️ БІЙ\n\n"

        if cooldown_start_text:
            text += cooldown_start_text

        if player_effects_text:
            text += player_effects_text

        if resource_start_text:
            text += resource_start_text

        if resource_attack_text:
            text += resource_attack_text

        if enemy_effect_text:
            text += enemy_effect_text

        if resource_damage_text:
            text += resource_damage_text

        if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or enemy_effect_text or resource_damage_text:
            text += "\n"

        if not player_attack_hit:
            text += f"💨 ПРОМАХ! {character_name} не влучив у {mob['name']}"
        elif is_player_crit:
            text += f"💥 КРИТ! {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"
        else:
            text += f"🗡️ {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"


        text += "\n"
        text += enemy_action_text

        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)

        text += (
            f"❤️ {character_name}: {player_hp}/{player_max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(player_hp, player_max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}\n"
            f"👹 {mob['name']}: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}"
        )

        text = append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n\n🔴 Повний шлунок: {mob['potion_cooldown']} ход."


        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "✨ Навички")
    def show_skills(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Ти не в бою",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)

        text, kb = build_skill_menu_text(user_id, mob)

        if not kb:
    
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )
        
    # Старий обробник текстових кнопок скілів (не використовується, тепер використовуємо inline)
    # @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: any(
    #     skill_name in m.text 
    #     for class_skills in CLASS_SKILLS_V1.values() 
    #     for skill_name in [s["name"] for s in class_skills]
    # ))
    def use_skill_text_button(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Ти не в бою",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"
        class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
        class_skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
        
        # Знайти навичку за ім'ям
        skill = None
        for s in class_skills:
            if s["name"] == message.text:
                skill = s
                break
        
        if not skill:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Навичку не знайдено.",
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_result = validate_skill_cooldown(mob, skill)
        if not cooldown_result["success"]:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                cooldown_result["message"],
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        player_effects_text += _apply_boss_dot_at_player_turn_15_5_0(mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)
        
        pay_result = validate_and_pay_skill_cost(user_id, mob, skill)
        if not pay_result["success"]:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                pay_result["message"],
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Персонажа не знайдено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats
        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)
        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp
        
        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]
            
        skill_attack_type = skill.get("attack_type", attack_profile["attack_type"])
        
        if skill.get("no_damage"):
            base_dmg = 0
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0
        else:
            if skill_attack_type == "magical":
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "magical")
                player_stat_attack = int_
            else:
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "physical")
                player_stat_attack = attack_profile["stat_attack"]
                
            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=player_stat_attack,
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=skill_attack_type,
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"],
                weapon_subtype=attack_profile.get("weapon_subtype", ""),
            )
            
            base_dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)
            
            dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * float(skill.get("damage_multiplier", 1.0)))))
            
            if skill.get("scales_with_spent_rage"):
                spent_rage = mob.get("last_skill_spent_rage", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_rage / 100)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier)))
                
            if skill.get("scales_with_player_pdef"):
                player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(player_pdef * 0.85)))
                
            if skill.get("scales_with_combo"):
                spent_combo = mob.get("last_skill_spent_combo", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_combo * 0.35)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier)))
                
            mob["hp"] -= dmg
            mob["_last_player_damage"] = int(dmg or 0)
            mob["_last_player_crit"] = bool(is_player_crit)
            
        resource_attack_text = ""
        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            if mob.get("player_resource_type") == "rage":
                resource_attack_text += add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)
                
        combo_gain = int(skill.get("combo_gain", 0))
        if combo_gain > 0:
            resource_attack_text += add_rogue_combo_point(mob, combo_gain)
            
        resource_attack_text += apply_extra_rage_from_skill(mob, skill)
        
        stun_text = ""
        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            stun_text = roll_skill_stun(mob, skill)
            
        special_effect_text = apply_skill_special_effect(
            user_id=user_id,
            mob=mob,
            skill=skill,
            damage_done=dmg
        )
        
        cooldown_set_text = set_skill_cooldown(
            mob,
            skill["key"],
            skill.get("cooldown", 0)
        )
        
        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""
            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text
                
            prefix_text += f"✨ Навичка: {skill['name']}\n"
            if skill.get("no_damage"):
                prefix_text += "Навичка застосована.\n"
            else:
                prefix_text += f"Ти завдав {dmg} шкоди.\n"
                
            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return
            
        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")
        
        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""
            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text
                prefix_text += enemy_effect_text
                
            prefix_text += f"✨ Навичка: {skill['name']}\n"
            prefix_text += "Ворог повалений ефектами.\n"
            
            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return
            
        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""
        
        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1
            enemy_action_text = f"💫 {mob['name']} оглушений і пропускає хід.\n\n"
        else:
            mob_attack_result = _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob=mob,
                player_pdef=player_pdef,
                player_mdef=player_mdef,
                player_dex=dex_,
                sta=sta_,
                level=lvl,
            )
            
            mob_dmg = mob_attack_result["damage"]
            is_mob_crit = mob_attack_result["is_crit"]
            is_dodge = mob_attack_result["is_dodge"]
            
            shield_text = ""
            if not is_dodge and mob_dmg > 0:
                mob_dmg, shield_text = apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, mob_dmg)
            boss_action_text = _finalize_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob, mob_attack_result, mob_dmg
            )
                
            player_hp -= mob_dmg
            
            resource_damage_text = add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, mob_dmg)
            
            if is_dodge:
                enemy_action_text = f"💨 УХИЛ! {character_name} уникнув атаки {mob['name']}\n\n"
            elif is_mob_crit:
                enemy_action_text = f"💥 КРИТ {mob['name']}! {character_name} отримав {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
            else:
                enemy_action_text = f"👹 {mob['name']} завдав {character_name} {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
                
        if mob.get("is_boss") and 'boss_action_text' in locals() and boss_action_text:
            enemy_action_text = boss_action_text

        if player_hp <= 0:
            durability_damage = damage_equipped_items_on_death(
                user_id=user_id
            )
            set_current_hp(user_id, 1)
            try:
                from db import reset_hp_regen_timers_now
                reset_hp_regen_timers_now(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass
            mp_restore_result = apply_post_combat_mp_floor_17_15_1(user_id)
            
            if user_id in bot.user_data:
                del bot.user_data[user_id]
                
            text = build_lethal_combat_log(
                turn_context=locals(),
                player_hp=player_hp,
                player_max_hp=player_max_hp,
                durability_damage=durability_damage,
            )
            text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)
            
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)
        
        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            mob["potion_cooldown"] -= 1
            
        text = "✨ НАВИЧКА\n\n"
        if cooldown_start_text:
            text += cooldown_start_text
        if player_effects_text:
            text += player_effects_text
        if resource_start_text:
            text += resource_start_text
        if resource_attack_text:
            text += resource_attack_text
        if cooldown_set_text:
            text += cooldown_set_text
        if special_effect_text:
            text += special_effect_text
        if enemy_effect_text:
            text += enemy_effect_text
        if resource_damage_text:
            text += resource_damage_text
            
        if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text or resource_damage_text:
            text += "\n"
            
        text += f"{skill['name']}\n"
        
        if skill.get("no_damage"):
            text += "✨ Навичка застосована.\n"
        else:
            if is_player_crit:
                text += f"💥 КРИТ! {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"
            else:
                text += f"✨ {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"
                
                
            text += "\n"
            
        text += enemy_action_text
        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)
        
        text += (
            f"❤️ {character_name}: {player_hp}/{player_max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(player_hp, player_max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}\n"
            f"👹 {mob['name']}: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}"
        )
        
        text = append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob)
        
        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n\n🔴 Повний шлунок: {mob['potion_cooldown']} ход."
            
        class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
        skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
        
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("skill_locked:"))
    def skill_locked(call):
            from systems.pve_skill_action_state import get_pve_skill_action_state

            user_id = call.from_user.id
            if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "❗ Бій уже завершено")
                return

            mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
            parts = str(call.data or "").split(":", 2)
            skill_key = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
            skill = get_player_skill_by_key(user_id, skill_key)
            if not skill:
                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "❌ Навичку не знайдено")
                return

            state = get_pve_skill_action_state(user_id, mob, skill)
            if state.get("available"):
                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "✅ Навичка вже доступна")
                return

            bot.answer_callback_query(
                call.id,
                state.get("message") or "🔒 Навичка зараз недоступна.",
                show_alert=True,
            )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "combat_attack")
    def combat_attack_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        if not _combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1(bot, call, "attack"):
            return
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❗ Спочатку почни полювання",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        # Викликаємо вже існуючу логіку атаки
        class FakeMessage:
            def __init__(self, chat_id, from_user_id):
                self.chat = type('obj', (object,), {'id': chat_id})
                self.from_user = type('obj', (object,), {'id': from_user_id})
        
        message = FakeMessage(call.message.chat.id, user_id)
        attack(message)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("combat_skill_locked:"))
    def combat_skill_locked_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        skill_key = call.data.split(":")[1]
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "❗ Бій вже завершено")
            return
            
        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        skill = get_player_skill_by_key(user_id, skill_key)
        cooldown = get_skill_cooldown(mob, skill["key"])
        
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, f"⏳ {skill['name']} ще перезаряджається: {cooldown} ходів")
        
    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("combat_use_skill:"))
    def combat_use_skill_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        if not _combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1(bot, call, "skill"):
            return
        skill_key = call.data.split(":")[1]
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❗ Бій вже завершено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"
        skill = get_player_skill_by_key(user_id, skill_key)
        class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
        
        if not skill:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❌ Навичку не знайдено.",
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_result = validate_skill_cooldown(mob, skill)
        if not cooldown_result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                cooldown_result["message"],
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        player_effects_text += _apply_boss_dot_at_player_turn_15_5_0(mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)
        
        pay_result = validate_and_pay_skill_cost(user_id, mob, skill)
        if not pay_result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                pay_result["message"],
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

        if not stats:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❗ Персонажа не знайдено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        # Використовуємо здоров'я з mob, якщо воно там є, інакше з бази (на випадок старих сесій)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]

        skill_attack_type = skill.get("attack_type", attack_profile["attack_type"])

        if skill.get("no_damage"):
            base_dmg = 0
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0
        else:
            if skill_attack_type == "magical":
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "magical")
                player_stat_attack = int_
            else:
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "physical")
                player_stat_attack = attack_profile["stat_attack"]

            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=player_stat_attack,
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=skill_attack_type,
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"],
                weapon_subtype=attack_profile.get("weapon_subtype", ""),
            )

            base_dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)

            dmg = max(
                1,
                int(round(base_dmg * float(skill.get("damage_multiplier", 1.0))))
            )

            if skill.get("scales_with_spent_rage"):
                spent_rage = mob.get("last_skill_spent_rage", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_rage / 100)

                dmg = max(
                    1,
                    int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier))
                )

            if skill.get("scales_with_player_pdef"):
                player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

                dmg = max(
                    1,
                    int(round(player_pdef * 0.85))
                )

            if skill.get("scales_with_combo"):
                spent_combo = mob.get("last_skill_spent_combo", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_combo * 0.35)

                dmg = max(
                    1,
                    int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier))
                )

            mob["hp"] -= dmg
            mob["_last_player_damage"] = int(dmg or 0)
            mob["_last_player_crit"] = bool(is_player_crit)

        resource_attack_text = ""

        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            if mob.get("player_resource_type") == "rage":
                resource_attack_text += add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)

        combo_gain = int(skill.get("combo_gain", 0))

        if combo_gain > 0:
            resource_attack_text += add_rogue_combo_point(mob, combo_gain)

        resource_attack_text += apply_extra_rage_from_skill(mob, skill)

        stun_text = ""

        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            stun_text = roll_skill_stun(mob, skill)

        special_effect_text = apply_skill_special_effect(
            user_id=user_id,
            mob=mob,
            skill=skill,
            damage_done=dmg
        )

        cooldown_set_text = set_skill_cooldown(
            mob,
            skill["key"],
            skill.get("cooldown", 0)
        )

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text

            prefix_text += f"✨ Навичка: {skill['name']}\n"

            if skill.get("no_damage"):
                prefix_text += "Навичка застосована.\n"
            else:
                prefix_text += f"Ти завдав {dmg} шкоди.\n"

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text
                prefix_text += enemy_effect_text

            prefix_text += f"✨ Навичка: {skill['name']}\n"
            prefix_text += "Ворог повалений ефектами.\n"

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""

        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1
            enemy_action_text = f"💫 {mob['name']} оглушений і пропускає хід.\n\n"
        else:
            mob_attack_result = _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob=mob,
                player_pdef=player_pdef,
                player_mdef=player_mdef,
                player_dex=dex_,
                sta=sta_,
                level=lvl,
            )

            mob_dmg = mob_attack_result["damage"]
            is_mob_crit = mob_attack_result["is_crit"]
            is_dodge = mob_attack_result["is_dodge"]

            shield_text = ""

            if not is_dodge and mob_dmg > 0:
                mob_dmg, shield_text = apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, mob_dmg)
            boss_action_text = _finalize_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
                mob, mob_attack_result, mob_dmg
            )

            player_hp -= mob_dmg
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp

            resource_damage_text = add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, mob_dmg)

            if is_dodge:
                enemy_action_text = f"💨 УХИЛ! {character_name} уникнув атаки {mob['name']}\n\n"
            elif is_mob_crit:
                enemy_action_text = f"💥 КРИТ {mob['name']}! {character_name} отримав {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
            else:
                enemy_action_text = f"👹 {mob['name']} завдав {character_name} {mob_dmg} шкоди\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"

        if mob.get("is_boss") and 'boss_action_text' in locals() and boss_action_text:
            enemy_action_text = boss_action_text

        if player_hp <= 0:
            durability_damage = damage_equipped_items_on_death(
                user_id=user_id
            )

            set_current_hp(user_id, 1)
            try:
                from db import reset_hp_regen_timers_now
                reset_hp_regen_timers_now(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

            mp_restore_result = apply_post_combat_mp_floor_17_15_1(user_id)

            if user_id in bot.user_data:
                del bot.user_data[user_id]

            text = build_lethal_combat_log(
                turn_context=locals(),
                player_hp=player_hp,
                player_max_hp=player_max_hp,
                durability_damage=durability_damage,
            )
            text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            mob["potion_cooldown"] -= 1

        text = "✨ НАВИЧКА\n\n"

        if cooldown_start_text:
            text += cooldown_start_text

        if player_effects_text:
            text += player_effects_text

        if resource_start_text:
            text += resource_start_text

        if resource_attack_text:
            text += resource_attack_text

        if cooldown_set_text:
            text += cooldown_set_text

        if special_effect_text:
            text += special_effect_text

        if enemy_effect_text:
            text += enemy_effect_text

        if resource_damage_text:
            text += resource_damage_text

        if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text or resource_damage_text:
            text += "\n"

        text += f"{skill['name']}\n"

        if skill.get("no_damage"):
            text += "✨ Навичка застосована.\n"
        else:
            if is_player_crit:
                text += f"💥 КРИТ! {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"
            else:
                text += f"✨ {character_name} завдав {mob['name']} {dmg} шкоди"


            text += "\n"

        if stun_text:
            text += stun_text

        text += enemy_action_text

        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)

        text += (
            f"❤️ {character_name}: {player_hp}/{player_max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(player_hp, player_max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}\n"
            f"👹 {mob['name']}: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}"
        )

        text = append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n\n🔴 Повний шлунок: {mob['potion_cooldown']} ход."


        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("combat_potion_"))
    def use_selected_potion_in_combat(call):
            user_id = call.from_user.id
            if not _combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1(bot, call, "potion_use"):
                return

            if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

                    reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
                )
                return

            inventory_id = int(call.data.split("_")[2])
            cooldown_turns = get_potion_cooldown_turns_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

            potion_result = use_potion_from_inventory(user_id, inventory_id)

            if not potion_result["success"]:
                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        

                bot.send_message(
                    call.message.chat.id,
                    potion_result["message"],
                    reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
                )
                return

            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            mob["potion_cooldown"] = cooldown_turns

            resource = potion_result.get("resource", "hp")

            if resource == "mp":
                mob["player_mp"] = potion_result["new_mp"]
                mob["player_max_mp"] = potion_result["max_mp"]
            else:
                player_hp = potion_result["new_hp"]
                player_max_hp = potion_result["max_hp"]
                mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
                mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

            player_hp = mob.get("player_hp", get_current_hp(user_id))
            player_max_hp = mob.get("player_max_hp", get_max_hp(user_id))
            class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)

            text = (
                f"🧪 ЗІЛЛЯ\n\n"
                f"{potion_result['message']}\n\n"
                f"✅ Хід не витрачено — {mob['name']} не атакує після використання зілля.\n"
                f"🔴 Повний шлунок: {format_combat_turns_uk(cooldown_turns)}.\n\n"
                f"❤️ {character_name}: {player_hp}/{player_max_hp}\n"
                f"{hp_bar(player_hp, player_max_hp)}\n"
                f"{class_resource_text}\n"
                f"👹 {mob['name']}: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
                f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}"
            )

            text = append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob)


            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )


    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "🏃 Втекти")
    def escape(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(

                "❗ Ти не в бою",

            )
            return

        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
        kb.add(
            types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text="✅ Так, втекти",
                callback_data="escape_yes"

            types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text="❌ Ні, залишитись",
                callback_data="escape_no"
            )
        )

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "🏃 Ти точно хочеш втекти з бою?",
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "escape_yes")
    def escape_yes(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        encounter_id = None
        if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
            encounter_id = bot.user_data[user_id].get("pve_encounter_id")
        if encounter_id and not claim_pve_terminal(user_id, 'manual_escape', encounter_id):
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, STALE_COMBAT_TEXT, reply_markup=main_kb())
            return

        # Зберегти поточне здоров'я в базу перед втечею
        if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
            mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
            # Перевіряємо, чи маємо ми player_hp в mob, але якщо ні, то нічого не робимо
            if "player_hp" in mob:
                set_current_hp(user_id, mob["player_hp"])

        mp_restore_result = apply_post_combat_mp_floor_17_15_1(user_id)

        if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
            del bot.user_data[user_id]

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        text = "🏃 Ти втік з бою"
        text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "escape_no")
    def escape_no(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
            bot.send_message(

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]

        
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            "⚔️ Ти залишився в бою",
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )


# ==============================
# ✅ COMBAT SAFE SEND RATE LIMIT V1
# ==============================

# Telegram може повернути 429 Too Many Requests, якщо бот надсилає багато повідомлень
# або якщо старі callback-и обробляються повторно після exception.
# Цей wrapper не дає polling падати через 429: чекає retry_after і повторює send один раз.


def patch_combat_bot_rate_limit_safe_send(bot):
    if getattr(bot, "_rom_safe_send_patched", False):
        return

    original_send_message = bot.send_message
    bot._rom_original_send_message = original_send_message

    def safe_send_message(chat_id, text, *args, **kwargs):
        try:
            return original_send_message(chat_id, text, *args, **kwargs)
        except Exception as error:
            retry_after = None
            error_code = getattr(error, "error_code", None)
            result_json = getattr(error, "result_json", None)

            if isinstance(result_json, dict):
                parameters = result_json.get("parameters", {}) or {}
                retry_after = parameters.get("retry_after")

                if error_code is None:
                    error_code = result_json.get("error_code")

            description = str(error)

            is_rate_limit = (
                error_code == 429
                or "Too Many Requests" in description
                or "retry after" in description
            )

            if not is_rate_limit:
                raise

            if retry_after is None:
                retry_after = 3

            try:
                retry_after = int(retry_after)
            except Exception:
                retry_after = 3

            retry_after = max(1, min(60, retry_after))

            try:
                import time
                PRODUCTION_LOG_PRINT(PRODUCTION_LOGGER, 'warning', f"⚠️ Telegram rate limit 429. Waiting {retry_after + 1}s before retry send_message.")
                time.sleep(retry_after + 1)
                return original_send_message(chat_id, text, *args, **kwargs)
            except Exception as retry_error:
                PRODUCTION_LOG_PRINT(PRODUCTION_LOGGER, 'error', f"❌ send_message retry failed after 429: {retry_error}")
                return None

    bot.send_message = safe_send_message
    bot._rom_safe_send_patched = True

# ROM 17.14.1.1 SEPARATE LEVEL REWARD MESSAGE AND DEV EXP SETTER
import random

from telebot import types

from data.locations import LOCATIONS
from data.mobs import ALL_MOBS

from db import (
    get_current_location,
    get_contract_status,
    create_daily_contract,
    abandon_active_contract,
    claim_contract_reward
)

from keyboards import contracts_kb


# ==============================
# HELPERS
# ==============================

def get_unlocked_location_ids(player_level):
    unlocked = []

    for location_id, location in LOCATIONS.items():
        if player_level >= location["unlock_level"]:
            unlocked.append(location_id)

    return unlocked


def get_available_contract_mobs(player_level):
    """
    Контракт не може дати моба з недоступної локації.

    Правила:
    - локація моба має бути відкрита;
    - рівень моба в діапазоні player_level ± 1;
    - min_player_level моба має бути <= player_level.
    """

    unlocked_locations = get_unlocked_location_ids(player_level)

    available = []

    for mob in ALL_MOBS:
        mob_level = int(mob.get("level", 1))
        min_player_level = int(mob.get("min_player_level", 1))
        location_id = mob.get("location_id", "start_path")

        if location_id not in unlocked_locations:
            continue

        if min_player_level <= player_level and player_level - 1 <= mob_level <= player_level + 1:
            available.append(mob)

    if available:
        return available

    fallback = []

    for mob in ALL_MOBS:
        min_player_level = int(mob.get("min_player_level", 1))
        location_id = mob.get("location_id", "start_path")

        if location_id not in unlocked_locations:
            continue

        if min_player_level <= player_level:
            fallback.append(mob)

    return fallback


def choose_random_contract_mob(player_level):
    available_mobs = get_available_contract_mobs(player_level)

    if not available_mobs:
        return None

    return random.choice(available_mobs)


def build_contracts_text(user_id):
    status = get_contract_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return status["message"], None

    level = status["level"]
    unlocked = status["unlocked"]
    completed_today = status["completed_today"]
    daily_limit = status["daily_limit"]
    active_contract = status["active_contract"]

    text = (
        f"📜 Дошка контрактів\n\n"
        f"На дошці висять замовлення від варти, торговців і мандрівників.\n"
        f"Тут можна взяти щоденне завдання на конкретну істоту.\n\n"
        f"📆 Сьогодні здано контрактів: {completed_today}/{daily_limit}\n"
    )

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    if not unlocked:
        text += (
            f"\n🔒 Контракти відкриються з 5 рівня.\n"
            f"👤 Твій рівень: {level}\n\n"
            f"Поки що варто навчитися основам: полюванню, зіллям, "
            f"екіпіруванню та ремонту спорядження."
        )

        return text, kb

    if active_contract:
        completed = active_contract.get("completed", False)

        if completed:
            text += (
                f"\n✅ Контракт виконано!\n\n"
                f"📌 Контракт готовий до здачі:\n"
                f"🎯 Ціль: {active_contract['target_mob_name']}\n"
                f"🏷 Рівень цілі: {active_contract['target_mob_level']}\n"
                f"📈 Прогрес: "
                f"{active_contract['current_kills']}/{active_contract['target_kills']}\n"
                f"✨ Нагорода: {active_contract['reward_exp']} EXP\n\n"
                f"Повернення до Гільдії Найманців підтверджує виконання контракту."
            )

            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text="🎁 Здати контракт",
                callback_data="contract_claim"
            ))

            return text, kb

        text += (
            f"\n📌 Активний контракт:\n"
            f"🎯 Ціль: {active_contract['target_mob_name']}\n"
            f"🏷 Рівень цілі: {active_contract['target_mob_level']}\n"
            f"📈 Прогрес: "
            f"{active_contract['current_kills']}/{active_contract['target_kills']}\n"
            f"✨ Нагорода після здачі: {active_contract['reward_exp']} EXP\n\n"
            f"ℹ️ Прогрес зараховується тільки за вбивство саме цієї істоти.\n"
            f"⭐ Елітна версія цієї істоти також зараховується."
        )

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="❌ Скасувати контракт",
            callback_data="contract_abandon"
        ))

        return text, kb

    if completed_today >= daily_limit:
        text += (
            f"\n✅ Ліміт контрактів на сьогодні виконано.\n"
            f"Повертайся завтра за новими завданнями."
        )

        return text, kb

    text += (
        f"\n✅ Можна взяти новий контракт.\n"
        f"ℹ️ 1 контракт = досвід за 20 мобів твого рівня.\n"
        f"🎯 Ціль буде обрана випадково серед істот, "
        f"які доступні для твого рівня та відкритих локацій."
    )

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="📜 Взяти контракт",
        callback_data="contract_take"
    ))

    return text, kb

def register_contract_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "📜 Контракти")
    def show_contracts(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "📜 Ти підійшов до дошки контрактів.",
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_take")
    def take_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        status = get_contract_status(user_id)

        if not status["exists"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                status["message"],
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        if not status["unlocked"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                (
                    f"🔒 Контракти відкриються з 5 рівня.\n"
                    f"👤 Твій рівень: {status['level']}"
                ),
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        chosen_mob = choose_random_contract_mob(status["level"])

        if not chosen_mob:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❌ Не вдалося знайти доступного моба для контракту.",
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        target_mob_name = chosen_mob.get("name", "Невідома істота")
        target_mob_level = int(chosen_mob.get("level", status["level"]))

        result = create_daily_contract(
            user_id=user_id,
            target_mob_name=target_mob_name,
            target_mob_level=target_mob_level
        )

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_claim")
    def claim_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = claim_contract_reward(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        reward_message = str(result.get("level_up_reward_message") or "")
        if reward_message:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, reward_message)

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_abandon")
    def abandon_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = abandon_active_contract(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

def _item_from_text(text):

def _remember_shop_message(user_id, chat_id, message_id, item_id, quantity, stage):
    states[int(user_id)] = {
        "chat_id": int(chat_id),
        "message_id": int(message_id),
        "item_id": int(item_id),
        "quantity": int(quantity),
        "stage": str(stage),
    }


def _close_shop_session(bot, user_id, text="❌ Вибір покупки закрито."):
    state = states.pop(int(user_id), None)
    if not state:
        return False
    try:
        bot.edit_message_text(
            text,
            int(state["chat_id"]),
            int(state["message_id"]),
            reply_markup=None,
        )
    except Exception:
        try:
            bot.edit_message_reply_markup(
                int(state["chat_id"]),
                int(state["message_id"]),
                reply_markup=None,
            )
        except Exception:
            pass
    return True


def _active_shop_callback(call, *, item_id=None, quantity=None, stages=()):
    state = states.get(int(call.from_user.id))
    if not state:
        return False
    if int(state.get("chat_id", -1)) != int(call.message.chat.id):
        return False
    if int(state.get("message_id", -1)) != int(call.message.message_id):
        return False
    if item_id is not None and int(state.get("item_id", -1)) != int(item_id):
        return False
    if quantity is not None and int(state.get("quantity", -1)) != int(quantity):
        return False
    if stages and str(state.get("stage")) not in set(stages):
        return False
    return True


def _reject_stale_shop_callback(bot, call):
    try:
        bot.answer_callback_query(
            call.id,
            "Це меню покупки вже неактивне.",
            show_alert=True,
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

from telebot import types

from db import (
    get_daily_quest_status,
    claim_daily_quest_reward,
    reset_daily_quest_if_needed
)

from keyboards import townhall_kb


# ==============================
# HELPERS
# ==============================

def build_daily_quest_text(user_id):
    status = get_daily_quest_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return status["message"], None

    progress = status["progress"]
    target_count = status["target_count"]
    completed = status["completed"]
    reward_claimed = status["reward_claimed"]

    text = (
        "📆 Щоденне завдання\n\n"
        "Місцеві жителі потребують допомоги у боротьбі з монстрами.\n\n"
        "🎯 Ціль:\n"
        f"Вбити {target_count} монстрів\n\n"
        "📈 Прогрес:\n"
        f"{progress}/{target_count}\n\n"
        "🎁 Нагорода:\n"
        "🔴 Мале зілля здоров’я ×3\n"
        "🪙 Жетон Фіріуса ×5\n"
        "ℹ️ Жетони накопичуються та не зникають наступного дня.\n"
    )

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    if reward_claimed:
        text += "\n✅ Нагороду за сьогодні вже отримано."
        return text, kb

    if completed:
        text += "\n✅ Завдання виконано. Можна забрати нагороду."

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="🎁 Отримати нагороду",
            callback_data="daily_claim_reward"
        ))

        return text, kb

    text += "\nℹ️ Прогрес зараховується за перемогу над будь-яким монстром."

    return text, kb


# ==============================
# HANDLERS
# ==============================

def register_daily_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "📆 Щоденне завдання")
    def show_daily_quest(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        reset_daily_quest_if_needed(user_id)
        text, kb = build_daily_quest_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "🏛️ Ви знаходитесь у Ратуші.",
            reply_markup=townhall_kb()
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "daily_claim_reward")
    def claim_daily_reward(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = claim_daily_quest_reward(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=townhall_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_daily_quest_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

def parse_dev_rune_request(parts):
    from data.runes import RUNE_LEVELS, RUNE_STATS, get_rune_item_id

    if len(parts) < 3:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                "❌ Формат:\n"
                "/dev_rune STAT LEVEL [quantity]\n\n"
                "Доступні характеристики: STR, STA, DEX, INT, WIS\n"
                "Доступні рівні: 1-5"
            ),
        }
    stat = str(parts[1]).strip().upper()
    try:
        level = int(parts[2])
        quantity = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) >= 4 else 1
    except Exception:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Рівень і кількість мають бути цілими числами.",
        }
    if stat not in RUNE_STATS:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідома характеристика. Доступні: STR, STA, DEX, INT, WIS.",
        }
    if level not in RUNE_LEVELS:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Рівень руни має бути від 1 до 5.",
        }
    if quantity < 1 or quantity > 999:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Кількість має бути від 1 до 999.",
        }
    return {
        "success": True,
        "stat": stat,
        "level": level,
        "quantity": quantity,
        "item_id": get_rune_item_id(stat, level),
    }


def parse_dev_quantity_request(parts, default=1, maximum=999):
    try:
        quantity = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) >= 2 else int(default)
    except Exception:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Кількість має бути цілим числом."}
    if quantity < 1 or quantity > int(maximum):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"❌ Кількість має бути від 1 до {int(maximum)}.",
        }
    return {"success": True, "quantity": quantity}

def format_rune_drop_simulation(result):
    if not result.get("success"):

    levels = result["levels"]; stats = result["stats"]
    return (

    )

def parse_dev_drop_sim_request(text):
    parts=str(text or "").split()
    if len(parts)<2:
        return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Формат:\n/dev_drop_sim normal|elite|boss [trials] [all|equipment|trophy|stone|rune|potion|special]"}
    enemy=parts[1].lower()
    if enemy not in ("normal","elite","boss"):
        return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Тип ворога: normal, elite або boss."}
    try: trials=int(parts[2]) if len(parts)>=3 else 10000
    except Exception: return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Кількість симуляцій має бути цілим числом."}
    if trials<1 or trials>1000000: return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Кількість симуляцій: від 1 до 1000000."}
    group=parts[3].lower() if len(parts)>=4 else "all"
    if group not in ("all","equipment","gear","trophy","loot","stone","material","refine","refine_stone","rune","runes","potion","potions","special"):
        return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Група: all, equipment, trophy, stone, rune, potion або special."}
    return {"success":True,"enemy_type":enemy,"trials":trials,"group":group}


def format_universal_drop_simulation(result):
    trials=result["trials"]; counts=result["counts"]
    labels={"equipment":"Спорядження","trophy":"Трофеї","refine_stone":"Камінь Посилення","rune":"Руни","potion":"Зілля","success_rune":"Руна Успіху","simple_extractor":"Простий Екстрактор","perfect_extractor":"Досконалий Екстрактор"}
    lines=["🎲 DEV: універсальна симуляція дропу","",f"Тип ворога: {result['enemy_type']}",f"Симуляцій: {trials}",f"Група: {result['group']}",""]
    for key in ("equipment","trophy","refine_stone","rune","potion","success_rune","simple_extractor","perfect_extractor"):
        if key in counts or result["group"] in ("all","special",key):
            value=counts.get(key,0); lines.append(f"{labels[key]}: {value} ({value/trials*100:.2f}%)")
    if result["equipment_rarity"]:
        lines.extend(("","Рідкість спорядження:")); lines.extend(f"• {k}: {v}" for k,v in sorted(result["equipment_rarity"].items()))
    if result["rune_levels"]:
        lines.extend(("","Рівні рун:")); lines.extend(f"• {k}: {v}" for k,v in sorted(result["rune_levels"].items()))
    if result["rune_stats"]:
        lines.extend(("","Характеристики рун:")); lines.extend(f"• {k}: {v}" for k,v in sorted(result["rune_stats"].items()))
    if result["potion_items"]:
        names={401:"Мале HP",402:"Мале MP",403:"Середнє HP",404:"Середнє MP"}; lines.extend(("","Зілля:")); lines.extend(f"• {names.get(k,k)}: {v}" for k,v in sorted(result["potion_items"].items()))
    lines.extend(("",f"Усього результатів: {result['total_results']}","DB writes: 0","Generated equipment rows: 0"))
    return "\n".join(lines)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Fail-closed external URL navigation for ROM Stage 18.5.1."""
from telebot import types

from config import get_external_links_config

EXTERNAL_LINKS_BUTTON = "🔗 Корисні посилання"
EXTERNAL_LINKS_CLOSE_CALLBACK = "links:close"


def _external_links_text(has_links):
    if has_links:
        return "🔗 Корисні посилання\n\nОберіть потрібний ресурс:"
    return (
        "🔗 Корисні посилання\n\n"
        "Наразі доступні посилання ще не налаштовані."
    )


def _external_links_kb(links=None):
    links = dict(get_external_links_config() if links is None else links)
    keyboard = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    if links.get("game_chat"):
        keyboard.row(types.InlineKeyboardButton("💬 Чат гри", url=links["game_chat"]))
    if links.get("news_channel"):
        keyboard.row(types.InlineKeyboardButton("📰 Канал новин", url=links["news_channel"]))
    if links.get("support"):
        keyboard.row(types.InlineKeyboardButton("❤️ Підтримати проєкт", url=links["support"]))
    keyboard.row(types.InlineKeyboardButton("❌ Закрити", callback_data=EXTERNAL_LINKS_CLOSE_CALLBACK))
    return keyboard


def _return_account_menu(bot, chat_id, user_id, message_id):
    from handlers.city import build_account_menu_text_17_30_1_4, account_menu_kb_17_30_1_4
    try:
        bot.edit_message_reply_markup(chat_id, message_id, reply_markup=None)
    except Exception:
        pass
    bot.send_message(
        chat_id,
        build_account_menu_text_17_30_1_4(user_id),
        reply_markup=account_menu_kb_17_30_1_4(),
    )


def register_external_links_handlers(bot):
    @bot.message_handler(
        func=lambda message: str(getattr(message, "text", "") or "") == EXTERNAL_LINKS_BUTTON
    )
    def open_external_links(message):
        links = get_external_links_config()
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            _external_links_text(any(links.values())),
            reply_markup=_external_links_kb(links),
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(
        func=lambda call: str(getattr(call, "data", "") or "") == EXTERNAL_LINKS_CLOSE_CALLBACK
    )
    def close_external_links(call):
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        _return_account_menu(
            bot,
            call.message.chat.id,
            call.from_user.id,
            call.message.message_id,
        )

def guild_list_kb(user_id, page=0):
    rows = get_public_guild_list(limit=GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE + 1, offset=page * GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE)
    shown = rows[:GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE]

    kb = types.ReplyKeyboardMarkup(resize_keyboard=True)
    buttons = {}

    for guild in shown:
        member_count = guild["member_count"] if "member_count" in guild.keys() else get_guild_member_count(guild["id"])
        label = f"🏰 [{guild['tag']}] {guild['name']} ({member_count}/{guild['member_limit']})"
        # Telegram buttons should not be too long.
        if len(label) > 60:
            label = label[:57] + "..."
        buttons[label] = guild["id"]
        kb.add(label)

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append("⬅️ Назад")
    if len(rows) > GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE:
        nav.append("➡️ Далі")
    if nav:
        kb.add(*nav)

    kb.add("🔙 Зала Гільдій")

    GUILD_BROWSE_STATE[user_id] = {
        "page": page,
        "buttons": buttons,
        "selected_guild_id": None,
    }

    return kb


def guild_detail_kb(user_id, guild_id):

    if get_user_guild(user_id):

    else:
        if has_pending_guild_application(user_id, guild_id):
            kb.add("ℹ️ Заявку вже подано")
        else:
            kb.add("📨 Подати заявку")
        kb.add("📜 Переглянути гільдії")

    kb.add("🔙 Зала Гільдій")
    return kb

def validate_guild_name_for_ui(name):
    validation = validate_guild_name_contract(name)
    if not validation["success"]:
        return False, validation["message"]
    name = validation["name"]
    if get_guild_by_name_or_tag(name):
        return False, "❌ Гільдія з такою назвою або абревіатурою вже існує."
    return True, name



def validate_guild_tag_for_ui(tag):
    validation = validate_guild_tag_contract(tag)
    if not validation["success"]:
        return False, validation["message"]
    tag = validation["tag"]
    if get_guild_by_name_or_tag(tag):
        return False, "❌ Гільдія з такою абревіатурою вже існує."
    return True, tag

def format_ua_date(value):
    value = str(value or "").strip()
    if not value:
        return "невідомо"
    try:
        date_part = value.split("T", 1)[0].split(" ", 1)[0]
        year, month, day = date_part.split("-", 2)
        return f"{day}.{month}.{year}"
    except Exception:
        return value
