            row=conn.execute(sql,(int(snapshot["item_id"]),)).fetchone()
            if row: snapshot.update(dict(row))
    finally: conn.close()
    return snapshot

def parse_trade_item_quantity_input(value, maximum):
    text=str(value or "").strip()
    try: quantity=int(text)
    except (TypeError,ValueError):
        return {"success":False,"reason":"invalid_quantity","message":"Введіть ціле число."}
    maximum=max(0,int(maximum or 0))
    if quantity<0 or quantity>maximum:
        return {"success":False,"reason":"quantity_out_of_range","message":f"Можна вказати від 0 до {maximum}.","maximum":maximum}
    return {"success":True,"quantity":quantity,"maximum":maximum}

def parse_trade_gold_amount_input(value, wallet_gold):
    text=str(value or "").strip().replace(",",".")
    try: amount=round(float(text),2)
    except (TypeError,ValueError):
        return {"success":False,"reason":"invalid_gold","message":"Введіть коректну суму золота."}
    wallet=round(float(wallet_gold or 0),2)
    if amount<0 or amount>wallet:
        return {"success":False,"reason":"gold_out_of_range","message":f"Можна вказати від 0 до {wallet:.2f}.","maximum":wallet}
    parts=text.split(".",1)
    if len(parts)==2 and len(parts[1])>2:
        return {"success":False,"reason":"too_many_decimals","message":"Використовуйте не більше двох знаків після крапки."}
    return {"success":True,"gold_amount":amount,"maximum":wallet}

# ROM 12.7.0 PLAYER TRADE CONFIRMATION AND ATOMIC COMMIT
PLAYER_TRADE_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS = 300


def _trade_side_columns_12_7_0(trade, user_id):
    uid = int(user_id)
    if uid == int(trade["initiator_user_id"]):
        return "initiator", "initiator_ready", "initiator_confirmed"
    if uid == int(trade["recipient_user_id"]):
        return "recipient", "recipient_ready", "recipient_confirmed"
    return None, None, None


def set_player_trade_ready(trade_id, user_id, ready=True, *, expected_revision=None, now=None, db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM player_trades WHERE id=?", (int(trade_id),)
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "reason": "trade_not_found"}
        trade = dict(row)
        side, ready_col, _ = _trade_side_columns_12_7_0(trade, user_id)
        if not side:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "reason": "wrong_actor"}
        if trade["status"] not in ("editing", "confirming"):
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "reason": "trade_not_editable"}
        if expected_revision is not None and int(expected_revision) != int(trade["revision"]):
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "reason": "stale_revision",
                "trade": trade,
            }
        value = 1 if ready else 0
        previous_value = int(trade.get(ready_col) or 0)
        changed = previous_value != value
        stamp = _text(now)
        if changed:
            conn.execute(
                f"UPDATE player_trades SET {ready_col}=?,"
                "initiator_confirmed=0,recipient_confirmed=0,updated_at=? "
                "WHERE id=?",
                (value, stamp, int(trade_id)),
            )
        updated = dict(conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM player_trades WHERE id=?", (int(trade_id),)
        ).fetchone())
        status = (
            "confirming"
            if int(updated["initiator_ready"]) and int(updated["recipient_ready"])
            else "editing"
        )
        expires = _text(
            _parse(stamp) + timedelta(
                seconds=(
                    PLAYER_TRADE_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS
                    if status == "confirming"
                    else PLAYER_TRADE_EDITING_TTL_SECONDS
                )
            )
        )
        if changed or str(updated.get("status")) != status:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE player_trades SET status=?,expires_at=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?",
                (status, expires, stamp, int(trade_id)),
            )
            _trade_event(
                conn,
                int(trade_id),
                int(user_id),
                "ready_set" if value else "ready_cleared",
                int(trade["revision"]),
                stamp,
                json.dumps(
                    {"ready": bool(value), "status": status},
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
            )
        conn.commit()
        updated.update({"status": status, "expires_at": expires})
        return {
            "success": True,
            "trade": updated,
            "both_ready": status == "confirming",
            "changed": changed,
        }
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


def return_player_trade_to_editing(trade_id, user_id, *, expected_revision=None, now=None, db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM player_trades WHERE id=?", (int(trade_id),)
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "reason": "trade_not_found"}
        trade = dict(row)
        side, ready_col, confirm_col = _trade_side_columns_12_7_0(trade, user_id)
        if not side:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "reason": "wrong_actor"}
        if trade["status"] not in ("editing", "confirming"):
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "reason": "trade_not_editable"}
        # Unlocking one's own offer remains valid even if the other participant
        # changed the global revision while this participant's panel was stale.
        stamp = _text(now)
        expires = _text(
            _parse(stamp) + timedelta(seconds=PLAYER_TRADE_EDITING_TTL_SECONDS)
        )
        conn.execute(
            f"UPDATE player_trades SET status='editing',{ready_col}=0,"
            "initiator_confirmed=0,recipient_confirmed=0,updated_at=?,expires_at=? "
            "WHERE id=?",
            (stamp, expires, int(trade_id)),
        )
        _trade_event(
            conn, int(trade_id), int(user_id), "own_offer_unlocked",
            int(trade["revision"]), stamp,
            json.dumps({"side": side}, ensure_ascii=False),
        )
        conn.commit()
        return {
            "success": True,
            "trade_id": int(trade_id),
            "revision": int(trade["revision"]),
            "side": side,
            "cleared_ready_column": ready_col,
            "cleared_confirm_column": confirm_col,
        }
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


def _trade_commit_fail_12_7_0(conn, reason, message):
    conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": reason, "message": message}


def _trade_commit_validate_item_12_7_0(conn, trade_id, offer):
    inv = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=?", (int(offer["inventory_id"]), int(offer["owner_user_id"]))).fetchone()
    if not inv: return None, "Предмет більше не належить учаснику."
    quantity = int(offer["quantity"] or 0)
    if quantity <= 0 or int(inv["quantity"] or 0) < quantity: return None, "Кількість предмета змінилася."
    reserved = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM inventory_reservations WHERE inventory_id=? AND user_id=? AND reservation_type=? AND reference_id=?", (int(offer["inventory_id"]), int(offer["owner_user_id"]), TRADE_RESERVATION_TYPE, int(trade_id))).fetchone()[0]
    if int(reserved or 0) != quantity: return None, "Резервування предмета змінилося."
    item = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM items WHERE id=?", (int(inv["item_id"]),)).fetchone()
    if not item or int(inv["item_id"]) in (501, 602, 726, 728) or str(item["category"] or "").lower() == "trash": return None, "Предмет заборонено передавати."
    equipped = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=? AND inventory_id=?", (int(offer["owner_user_id"]), int(offer["inventory_id"]))).fetchone()
    if equipped: return None, "Екіпірований предмет не можна передати."
    return (dict(inv), dict(item)), None


def _trade_stack_slots_needed_12_7_0(conn, recipient, item_id, quantity, max_stack):
    room = 0
    for row in conn.execute("SELECT quantity FROM inventory WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=?", (recipient, item_id)):
        room += max(0, max_stack - int(row[0] or 0))
    return max(0, (max(0, quantity - room) + max_stack - 1) // max_stack)


def _trade_transfer_stack_12_7_0(conn, source, recipient, quantity, item):
    inv_id = int(source["id"]); item_id = int(source["item_id"]); remaining = int(quantity); max_stack = max(1, int(item.get("max_stack") or 1))
    source_qty = int(source.get("quantity") or 0)
    conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET quantity=quantity-? WHERE id=?", (remaining, inv_id))
    for row in conn.execute("SELECT id,quantity FROM inventory WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=? AND id<>? ORDER BY id", (recipient, item_id, inv_id)).fetchall():
        if remaining <= 0: break
        room = max(0, max_stack - int(row["quantity"] or 0)); add = min(room, remaining)
        if add: conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET quantity=quantity+? WHERE id=?", (add, int(row["id"]))); remaining -= add
    columns = [r[1] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(inventory)") if r[1] not in ("id", "user_id", "quantity")]
    while remaining > 0:
        add = min(max_stack, remaining); names = ["user_id", "item_id", "quantity"] + columns
        values = [recipient, item_id, add] + [source.get(name) for name in columns]
        conn.execute("INSERT INTO inventory(" + ",".join(names) + ") VALUES(" + ",".join("?" for _ in names) + ")", values); remaining -= add
    if source_qty == quantity: conn.execute("DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=?", (inv_id,))


def _trade_offer_snapshot_12_7_0(offers, owner):
    return json.dumps([dict(x) for x in offers if int(x["owner_user_id"]) == int(owner)], ensure_ascii=False, default=str, sort_keys=True)


def _commit_player_trade_12_7_0(conn, trade, offers, stamp):
    tid = int(trade["id"]); a = int(trade["initiator_user_id"]); b = int(trade["recipient_user_id"])
    gold = {a: 0.0, b: 0.0}; validated = []
    for offer in offers:
        offer = dict(offer)
        if offer["asset_type"] == "gold": gold[int(offer["owner_user_id"])] = round(float(offer["gold_amount"] or 0), 2); continue
        pair, error = _trade_commit_validate_item_12_7_0(conn, tid, offer)
        if error: return _trade_commit_fail_12_7_0(conn, "item_validation_failed", error)
        validated.append((offer, pair[0], pair[1]))
    wallets = {int(r["user_id"]): round(float(r["gold"] or 0),2) for r in conn.execute("SELECT user_id,gold FROM users WHERE user_id IN (?,?)", (a,b))}
    if wallets.get(a,0) < gold[a] or wallets.get(b,0) < gold[b]: return _trade_commit_fail_12_7_0(conn, "insufficient_gold", "Недостатньо золота для завершення обміну.")
    # Conservative capacity check after outgoing full rows and incoming new slots.
    for recipient in (a,b):
        used = int(conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE user_id=?", (recipient,)).fetchone()[0]); cap = int(conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(bag_slots,60) FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (recipient,)).fetchone()[0] or 60)  # ROM 17.8.1 BASE BAG CAPACITY 60
        outgoing_full = sum(1 for offer, inv, item in validated if int(offer["owner_user_id"]) == recipient and int(inv["quantity"] or 0) == int(offer["quantity"]) and int(item.get("max_stack") or 1) <= 1)
        incoming = 0
        for offer, inv, item in validated:
            if int(offer["owner_user_id"]) == recipient: continue
            if int(item.get("max_stack") or 1) <= 1: incoming += 1
            else: incoming += _trade_stack_slots_needed_12_7_0(conn, recipient, int(inv["item_id"]), int(offer["quantity"]), max(1,int(item.get("max_stack") or 1)))
        if used - outgoing_full + incoming > cap: return _trade_commit_fail_12_7_0(conn, "bag_full", "Недостатньо місця в сумці одного з учасників.")
    conn.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=ROUND(COALESCE(gold,0)-?+?,2) WHERE user_id=?", (gold[a],gold[b],a)); conn.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=ROUND(COALESCE(gold,0)-?+?,2) WHERE user_id=?", (gold[b],gold[a],b))
    for offer, inv, item in validated:
        owner=int(offer["owner_user_id"]); recipient=b if owner==a else a; quantity=int(offer["quantity"])
        if int(item.get("max_stack") or 1) <= 1:
            conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET user_id=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?", (recipient,int(inv["id"]),owner))
        else: _trade_transfer_stack_12_7_0(conn, inv, recipient, quantity, item)
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM inventory_reservations WHERE reservation_type=? AND reference_id=?", (TRADE_RESERVATION_TYPE,tid)); conn.execute("DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE activity_type='trade' AND reference_id=?", (str(tid),))
    conn.execute("UPDATE player_trades SET status='completed',completed_at=?,updated_at=?,expires_at=?,initiator_confirmed=1,recipient_confirmed=1 WHERE id=?", (stamp,stamp,stamp,tid))
    _trade_event(conn,tid,None,"completed",int(trade["revision"]),stamp,json.dumps({"gold":gold,"items":len(validated)},ensure_ascii=False))
    _write_trade_history(conn,trade,"completed",stamp)
    conn.execute("UPDATE player_trade_history SET initiator_offer_snapshot=?,recipient_offer_snapshot=?,summary_json=? WHERE trade_id=?", (_trade_offer_snapshot_12_7_0(offers,a),_trade_offer_snapshot_12_7_0(offers,b),json.dumps({"gold":gold,"item_offer_count":len(validated)},ensure_ascii=False),tid))
    conn.commit(); return {"success":True,"completed":True,"trade_id":tid,"initiator_user_id":a,"recipient_user_id":b,"revision":int(trade["revision"])}


def confirm_player_trade(trade_id, user_id, *, expected_revision=None, now=None, db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM player_trades WHERE id=?", (int(trade_id),)
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return _trade_commit_fail_12_7_0(
                conn, "trade_not_found", "Обмін не знайдено."
            )
        trade = dict(row)
        side, _, confirm_col = _trade_side_columns_12_7_0(trade, user_id)
        if not side:
            return _trade_commit_fail_12_7_0(
                conn, "wrong_actor", "Немає доступу до цього обміну."
            )
        if trade["status"] == "completed":
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": True,
                "completed": True,
                "idempotent": True,
                "changed": False,
                "trade_id": int(trade_id),
            }
        if (
            trade["status"] != "confirming"
            or not int(trade["initiator_ready"])
            or not int(trade["recipient_ready"])
        ):
            return _trade_commit_fail_12_7_0(
                conn, "not_ready", "Обидва учасники ще не готові."
            )
        if expected_revision is not None and int(expected_revision) != int(trade["revision"]):
            return _trade_commit_fail_12_7_0(
                conn, "stale_revision", "Пропозиція вже змінилася."
            )
        already_confirmed = bool(trade.get(confirm_col))
        stamp = _text(now)
        if not already_confirmed:
            conn.execute(
                f"UPDATE player_trades SET {confirm_col}=1,updated_at=? WHERE id=?",
                (stamp, int(trade_id)),
            )
            _trade_event(
                conn, int(trade_id), int(user_id), "final_confirmed",
                int(trade["revision"]), stamp,
            )
        trade = dict(conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM player_trades WHERE id=?", (int(trade_id),)
        ).fetchone())
        if not int(trade["initiator_confirmed"]) or not int(trade["recipient_confirmed"]):
            conn.commit()
            return {
                "success": True,
                "completed": False,
                "waiting": True,
                "changed": not already_confirmed,
                "trade": trade,
            }
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE player_trades SET status='committing',updated_at=? WHERE id=?",
            (stamp, int(trade_id)),
        )
        offers = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM player_trade_offers WHERE trade_id=? ORDER BY id",
            (int(trade_id),),
        ).fetchall()
        result = _commit_player_trade_12_7_0(conn, trade, offers, stamp)
        if isinstance(result, dict):
            result.setdefault("changed", not already_confirmed)
        return result
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


# ROM 12.6.4 PLAYER TRADE NAVIGATION LOCK AND ITEM CATEGORIES
PLAYER_TRADE_ITEM_CATEGORY_PAGE_SIZE = 8
PLAYER_TRADE_ITEM_CATEGORIES = ("equipment", "potion", "material", "rune", "consumable")


def _player_trade_item_category_12_6_4(item):
    """Return one exclusive trade UI category from canonical snapshot data."""
    item = item or {}
    snapshot = item.get("snapshot") or {}
    category = str(snapshot.get("category") or "").strip().lower()
    item_id = int(snapshot.get("item_id") or 0)

    # Explicit stack domains must win even when inventory compatibility fields
    # contain durability defaults.
    if 701 <= item_id <= 725 or category in ("rune", "runes", "stat_rune"):
        return "rune"
    if category in ("potion", "potions", "heal_potion", "mana_potion"):
        return "potion"
    if item_id == 503 or category in ("consumable", "consumables"):
        return "consumable"
    if category in ("material", "materials", "special_material", "refine_material"):
        return "material"

    if item.get("is_equipment") or _trade_offer_is_equipment_snapshot(snapshot):
        return "equipment"
    return "material"


def get_tradeable_inventory_for_trade_category(
    trade_id, user_id, category, *, page=0, page_size=8, db_path=None
):
    category = str(category or "").strip().lower()
    if category not in PLAYER_TRADE_ITEM_CATEGORIES:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "invalid_category", "items": []}
    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    page_size = max(1, min(20, int(page_size or 8)))
    collected = []
    source_page = 0
    while source_page < 100:
        batch = get_tradeable_inventory_for_trade(
            trade_id, user_id, page=source_page, page_size=20, db_path=db_path)
        if not batch.get("success"):
            return batch
        for item in batch.get("items", []):
            if _player_trade_item_category_12_6_4(item) == category:
                enriched = dict(item)
                enriched["trade_category"] = category
                collected.append(enriched)
        if not batch.get("has_next"):
            break
        source_page += 1
    total = len(collected)
    if total == 0:
        page = 0
    elif page * page_size >= total:
        page = (total - 1) // page_size
    start = page * page_size
    return {
        "success": True,
        "trade_id": int(trade_id),
        "category": category,
        "page": page,
        "page_size": page_size,
        "total": total,
        "items": collected[start:start + page_size],
        "has_previous": page > 0,
        "has_next": start + page_size < total,
    }


def get_player_trade_category_counts(trade_id, user_id, *, db_path=None):
    counts = {}
    for category in PLAYER_TRADE_ITEM_CATEGORIES:
        result = get_tradeable_inventory_for_trade_category(
            trade_id, user_id, category, page=0,
            page_size=PLAYER_TRADE_ITEM_CATEGORY_PAGE_SIZE, db_path=db_path)
        if not result.get("success"):
            return result
        counts[category] = int(result.get("total") or 0)
    return {"success": True, "trade_id": int(trade_id), "counts": counts}

def get_player_ranking_position(ranking_key,user_id,db_path=None):

def _legacy_function(name: str) -> Optional[Callable[..., Any]]:
    db = _db_module()
    return getattr(db, f"_legacy_{name}_before_player_system_v1", None)


def _fetchone(sql: str, params: tuple = ()):  # sqlite3.Row or tuple depending on project state
    db = _db_module()
    db.cursor.execute(sql, params)
    return db.cursor.fetchone()


def _execute_commit(sql: str, params: tuple = ()):
    db = _db_module()
    db.cursor.execute(sql, params)
    db.conn.commit()


def _row_get(row, key: str, index: int = 0, default=None):
    if row is None:
        return default
    try:
        return row[key]
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        return row[index]
    except Exception:
        return default


def get_player_stats(user_id: int):
    """Return total STR/DEX/INT/WIS/STA and level exactly once.

    Total primary stats are base database values plus bonuses from active,
    unbroken equipped items and runes installed in active, unbroken equipment.
    """
    row = _player_base_row_9_0_12g(user_id)
    if not row:
        return None
    base_str, base_dex, base_int, base_wis, base_sta, level = row
    db = _player_combat_db_9_0_12g()
    bonuses = db.get_item_bonuses(int(user_id))
    try:
        item_str, item_dex, item_int, item_wis, item_sta = bonuses
    except Exception:
        item_str = item_dex = item_int = item_wis = item_sta = 0
    try:
        from systems.rune_system import get_equipped_rune_stat_totals
        rune = get_equipped_rune_stat_totals(user_id)
    except Exception:
        rune = {}
    return (
        int(base_str or 0) + int(item_str or 0) + int(rune.get("str", 0) or 0),
        int(base_dex or 0) + int(item_dex or 0) + int(rune.get("dex", 0) or 0),
        int(base_int or 0) + int(item_int or 0) + int(rune.get("int", 0) or 0),
        int(base_wis or 0) + int(item_wis or 0) + int(rune.get("wis", 0) or 0),
        int(base_sta or 0) + int(item_sta or 0) + int(rune.get("sta", 0) or 0),
        max(1, int(level or 1)),
    )

def add_kill(user_id: int, amount: int = 1):
    """
    Compatibility fix.

    У старому db.py актуальна legacy-функція add_kill() має сигнатуру:
        add_kill(user_id)

    А facade 9.0.2 викликав legacy як:
        legacy(user_id, amount)

    Через це після бою виникало:
        TypeError: add_kill() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given

    Правильна сумісна логіка:
    - якщо amount == 1, пробуємо старий legacy(user_id);
    - якщо amount > 1 і legacy підтримує тільки 1 аргумент, викликаємо legacy(user_id) кілька разів;
    - якщо legacy відсутній, використовуємо fallback UPDATE.
    """

    legacy = _legacy_function("add_kill")

    if legacy:
        try:
            return legacy(user_id, amount)
        except TypeError:
            safe_amount = max(1, int(amount or 1))
            result = None
            for _ in range(safe_amount):
                result = legacy(user_id)
            return result

    try:
        safe_amount = max(1, int(amount or 1))
        _execute_commit(
            "UPDATE users SET kills=COALESCE(kills, 0)+? WHERE user_id=?",
            (safe_amount, user_id),
        )
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

def sync_user_max_hp(user_id: int, heal_to_full: bool = False):
    """
    Synchronize stored users.max_hp with the real dynamic get_max_hp(user_id).

    Important gameplay rule:
    - Equipping +HP armor raises max HP but does NOT heal missing HP automatically.
    - Removing +HP armor lowers max HP and clamps current HP if it is above new max.

    This fixes stale max_hp in DB, which may cause notification worker to say
    "full HP" using stored max_hp while dynamic max HP from refined armor is higher.
    """

    db = _db_module()
    dynamic_max_hp = int(get_max_hp(user_id) or 1)

    try:
        row = _fetchone("SELECT hp, max_hp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    except Exception:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "max_hp": dynamic_max_hp,
            "hp": dynamic_max_hp if heal_to_full else 0,
            "changed": False,
        }

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "max_hp": dynamic_max_hp,
            "hp": 0,
            "changed": False,
        }

    current_hp = int(_row_get(row, "hp", 0, dynamic_max_hp) or 0)
    stored_max_hp = int(_row_get(row, "max_hp", 1, dynamic_max_hp) or dynamic_max_hp)

    if heal_to_full:
        new_hp = dynamic_max_hp
    else:
        new_hp = min(current_hp, dynamic_max_hp)

    changed = (stored_max_hp != dynamic_max_hp) or (current_hp != new_hp)

    if changed:
        try:
            _execute_commit(
                "UPDATE users SET hp=?, max_hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                (new_hp, dynamic_max_hp, user_id),
            )
        except Exception:
            # If max_hp column is absent in some older DB, still try to clamp hp.
            try:
                _execute_commit(
                    "UPDATE users SET hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (new_hp, user_id),
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

    return {
        "success": True,
        "hp": new_hp,
        "max_hp": dynamic_max_hp,
        "old_hp": current_hp,
        "old_max_hp": stored_max_hp,
        "changed": changed,
    }


def get_current_hp_raw(user_id: int):
    sync = sync_user_max_hp(user_id, heal_to_full=False)

    if sync.get("success"):
        return int(sync.get("hp", 0) or 0)

    if _player_system_base_get_current_hp_raw_before_hp_sync_v1:
        return _player_system_base_get_current_hp_raw_before_hp_sync_v1(user_id)

    row = _fetchone("SELECT hp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    return int(_row_get(row, "hp", 0, get_max_hp(user_id)) or get_max_hp(user_id))


def get_current_hp(user_id: int):
    sync = sync_user_max_hp(user_id, heal_to_full=False)

    if sync.get("success"):

    if _player_system_base_get_current_hp_before_hp_sync_v1:
        return _player_system_base_get_current_hp_before_hp_sync_v1(user_id)

    return get_current_hp_raw(user_id)

def get_attack(user_id):

    strength, dexterity, intelligence, wisdom, stamina = get_player_stats(user_id)[:5]

def _armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent_9_0_12g(user_id):
    db = _player_combat_db_9_0_12g()
    rows = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT it.slot_key, it.rarity, COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0), "
        "COALESCE(inv.durability,100) "
        "FROM equipment_slots es "
        "JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id "
        "JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "
        "WHERE es.user_id=?",
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchall()
    total = 0.0
    try:
        from systems.refine_system import get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent
    except Exception:
        return 0.0
    for slot_key, rarity, refine_level, durability in rows:
        if slot_key not in _ARMOR_SLOTS_9_0_12G:
            continue
        if int(durability or 0) <= 0:
            continue
        total += float(get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(refine_level, rarity) or 0.0)
    return round(total, 4)


def get_max_hp(user_id: int):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
    if not stats:
        return get_starting_max_hp()
    _str, _dex, _int, _wis, total_sta, level = stats
    base_hp = calculate_base_max_hp(level, total_sta)
    refine_percent = _armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent_9_0_12g(user_id)
    return max(1, int(round(base_hp * (1.0 + refine_percent / 100.0))))

# Stage 17.14.1 authoritative transactional EXP override.
def add_exp(user_id: int, amount):
    """Apply EXP, stats, HP and exactly-once level rewards in one transaction."""
    db = _db_module()
    from systems.level_up_reward_system import (
        apply_level_up_rewards_in_transaction,
        build_level_up_reward_message,
        init_level_up_reward_system,
    )

    init_level_up_reward_system(db)
    db.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    try:
        row = db.cursor.execute(
            "SELECT level, exp FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
            (user_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            db.conn.rollback()
            return None

        old_level = int(_row_get(row, "level", 0, 1) or 1)
        level = old_level

def _consume_potion_and_compact_stacks_17_5_1_1(

    user_id, inventory_id, item_id, max_stack, *, resource, new_value, max_value

):

    """Consume one potion, compact same-item stacks, and update resource atomically."""

    # ROM 17.5.1.1 ATOMIC POTION CONSUME AND STACK COMPACTION

    from db_modules.connection import conn, cursor



    user_id = int(user_id)

    inventory_id = int(inventory_id)

    item_id = int(item_id)

    max_stack = max(1, int(max_stack or 1))

    savepoint = "rom_potion_17_5_1_1"

    try:

        cursor.execute(f"SAVEPOINT {savepoint}")

        active = cursor.execute(

            "SELECT quantity FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=? AND item_id=?",

            (inventory_id, user_id, item_id),

        ).fetchone()

        if not active or int(active[0] or 0) <= 0:

            cursor.execute(f"ROLLBACK TO {savepoint}")

            cursor.execute(f"RELEASE {savepoint}")

            return {"success": False, "reason": "stale_inventory"}



        rows = cursor.execute(

            """SELECT id, quantity FROM inventory

               WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=? AND quantity>0

               ORDER BY id ASC""",

            (user_id, item_id),

        ).fetchall()

        total_before = sum(max(0, int(row[1] or 0)) for row in rows)

        total_after = total_before - 1

        if total_after < 0:

            raise RuntimeError("Potion total became negative.")



        remaining = total_after

        canonical_inventory_id = None

        for row_id, _quantity in rows:

            row_id = int(row_id)

            target = min(max_stack, remaining)

            if target > 0:

                cursor.execute(

                    "UPDATE inventory SET quantity=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=? AND item_id=?",

                    (target, row_id, user_id, item_id),

                )

                if cursor.rowcount != 1:

                    raise RuntimeError("Failed to compact potion stack.")

                if canonical_inventory_id is None:

                    canonical_inventory_id = row_id

                remaining -= target

            else:

                cursor.execute(

                    "DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=? AND item_id=?",

                    (row_id, user_id, item_id),

                )

        if remaining != 0:

            raise RuntimeError("Potion stack capacity invariant failed.")



        if resource == "hp":

            changed = cursor.execute(

                "UPDATE users SET hp=? WHERE user_id=?",

                (int(new_value), user_id),

            ).rowcount

        elif resource == "mp":

            changed = cursor.execute(

                "UPDATE users SET mp=?, max_mp=? WHERE user_id=?",

                (int(new_value), int(max_value), user_id),

            ).rowcount

        else:

            raise RuntimeError("Unsupported potion resource.")

        if changed != 1:

            raise RuntimeError("Player resource update failed.")



        cursor.execute(f"RELEASE {savepoint}")

        conn.commit()

        return {

            "success": True,

            "inventory_id": canonical_inventory_id,

            "consumed_inventory_id": inventory_id,

            "remaining_total": total_after,

            "stack_count": (total_after + max_stack - 1) // max_stack if total_after else 0,

        }

    except Exception as error:

        try:

            cursor.execute(f"ROLLBACK TO {savepoint}")

            cursor.execute(f"RELEASE {savepoint}")

        except Exception:

            conn.rollback()

        return {"success": False, "reason": "transaction_failed", "error": str(error)}



def use_potion_from_inventory(user_id, inventory_id):

    """Use one supported potion and return the canonical post-compaction stack."""

    entry = get_inventory_entry(user_id, inventory_id)

    if not entry:

        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Предмет не знайдено в інвентарі"}



    inv_id, item_id, name, item_type, category, quantity = entry

    if category != "potion":

        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Це не зілля"}

    potion = POTIONS.get(item_id)

    if not potion:

        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Це зілля ще не підтримується"}



    if potion["type"] == "mp":

        mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)

        if isinstance(mp_data, dict):

            current_mp = int(mp_data.get("mp", mp_data.get("current_mp", 0)) or 0)

            max_mp = int(mp_data.get("max_mp", 0) or 0)

        else:

            current_mp = int(mp_data or 0)

            try:

                from db import get_max_mp

                max_mp = int(get_max_mp(user_id) or 0)

            except Exception:

                max_mp = 0

        if max_mp <= 0:

            return {"success": False, "message": "🔵 Твій клас не використовує ману"}

        if current_mp >= max_mp:

            return {"success": False, "message": "🔵 Мана вже повна"}

        new_mp = min(max_mp, current_mp + int(potion["restore"]))

        real_restore = new_mp - current_mp

        mutation = _consume_potion_and_compact_stacks_17_5_1_1(

            user_id, inv_id, item_id, potion["max_stack"],

            resource="mp", new_value=new_mp, max_value=max_mp,

        )

        if not mutation.get("success"):

            message = "❌ Предмет не знайдено в інвентарі" if mutation.get("reason") == "stale_inventory" else "❌ Не вдалося використати зілля"

            return {"success": False, "message": message}

        return {

            "success": True, "resource": "mp",

            "message": f"{potion['name']} використано.\n🔵 Відновлено: +{real_restore} MP\n🔵 Мана: {new_mp}/{max_mp}",

            "restore_mp": real_restore, "new_mp": new_mp, "max_mp": max_mp,

            **mutation,

        }



    current_hp = get_current_hp(user_id)

    max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    if current_hp >= max_hp:

        return {"success": False, "message": "❤️ Здоров’я вже повне"}

    new_hp = min(max_hp, current_hp + int(potion["restore"]))

    real_heal = new_hp - current_hp

    mutation = _consume_potion_and_compact_stacks_17_5_1_1(

        user_id, inv_id, item_id, potion["max_stack"],

        resource="hp", new_value=new_hp, max_value=max_hp,

    )

    if not mutation.get("success"):

        message = "❌ Предмет не знайдено в інвентарі" if mutation.get("reason") == "stale_inventory" else "❌ Не вдалося використати зілля"

        return {"success": False, "message": message}

    return {

        "success": True, "resource": "hp",

        "message": f"{potion['name']} використано.\n❤️ Відновлено: +{real_heal} HP\n❤️ Здоров’я: {new_hp}/{max_hp}",

        "heal": real_heal, "new_hp": new_hp, "max_hp": max_hp,

        **mutation,

    }

                    )

            pass

    return result

# ROM 17.19.3 ALCHEMIST POTION BUY SELL
def get_alchemist_potion_stock_17_19_3(user_id):
    """Return total, reserved and sellable quantities for canonical Alchemist potions."""
    from db_modules.connection import cursor
    try:
        from systems.player_interaction_system import get_inventory_reserved_quantity
    except Exception:
        get_inventory_reserved_quantity = None
    potion_ids = tuple(int(item_id) for item_id in ALCHEMIST_SHOP)
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in potion_ids)
    rows = cursor.execute(
        f"""SELECT inv.id, inv.item_id, COALESCE(inv.quantity,0),
                   it.name, COALESCE(it.sell_price,0)
            FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id
            WHERE inv.user_id=? AND inv.item_id IN ({placeholders})
            ORDER BY inv.item_id, inv.id""",
        (int(user_id), *potion_ids),
    ).fetchall()
    grouped = {}
    for inventory_id,item_id,quantity,name,sell_price in rows:
        item_id=int(item_id); quantity=max(0,int(quantity or 0))
        reserved=0
        if get_inventory_reserved_quantity is not None:
            try: reserved=max(0,int(get_inventory_reserved_quantity(int(inventory_id)) or 0))
            except TypeError:
                try: reserved=max(0,int(get_inventory_reserved_quantity(int(user_id),int(inventory_id)) or 0))
                except Exception: reserved=0
            except Exception: reserved=0
        rec=grouped.setdefault(item_id,{"item_id":item_id,"name":str(name),"sell_price":float(sell_price or 0),"total":0,"reserved":0,"available":0})
        rec["total"] += quantity; rec["reserved"] += min(quantity,reserved); rec["available"] += max(0,quantity-reserved)
    return [grouped[i] for i in sorted(grouped)]

# ROM 17.19.3.5 ALCHEMIST BUY RETURN POTION STACK NORMALIZATION
def build_potion_stack_plan_17_19_3_5(rows, max_stack):
    """Pure reservation-safe compaction plan.

    rows: iterable of (inventory_id, quantity, reserved_quantity).
    Reserved quantities stay attached to their inventory IDs. Free quantities are
    packed into the earliest rows up to max_stack. Empty unreserved rows become 0.
    """
    max_stack = max(1, int(max_stack or 1))
    normalized = []
    free_total = 0
    prepared = []
    for inventory_id, quantity, reserved in rows:
        quantity = max(0, int(quantity or 0))
        reserved = max(0, min(quantity, int(reserved or 0)))
        prepared.append((int(inventory_id), quantity, reserved))
        free_total += quantity - reserved
    for inventory_id, _quantity, reserved in prepared:
        capacity = max(0, max_stack - reserved)
        allocated = min(free_total, capacity)
        normalized.append((inventory_id, reserved + allocated))
        free_total -= allocated
    if free_total != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("Недостатня місткість наявних стаків для нормалізації")
    return normalized


def normalize_potion_stacks_17_19_3_5(user_id, item_id, cursor_obj=None):
    """Compact potion stacks inside the caller-owned transaction."""
    if int(item_id) not in ALCHEMIST_SHOP:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "unsupported_item"}
    if cursor_obj is None:
        from db_modules.connection import cursor as cursor_obj
    item_row = cursor_obj.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(max_stack,1) FROM items WHERE id=?", (int(item_id),)
    ).fetchone()
    max_stack = max(1, int((item_row[0] if item_row else 1) or 1))
    rows = cursor_obj.execute(
        """SELECT inv.id, COALESCE(inv.quantity,0),
                  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.quantity) FROM inventory_reservations r
                            WHERE r.inventory_id=inv.id),0)
           FROM inventory inv
           WHERE inv.user_id=? AND inv.item_id=?
           ORDER BY inv.id""",
        (int(user_id), int(item_id)),
    ).fetchall()
    plan = build_potion_stack_plan_17_19_3_5(rows, max_stack)
    for inventory_id, new_quantity in plan:
        if int(new_quantity) <= 0:
            cursor_obj.execute(
                "DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=? AND item_id=?",
                (int(inventory_id), int(user_id), int(item_id)),
            )
        else:
            cursor_obj.execute(
                "UPDATE inventory SET quantity=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=? AND item_id=?",
                (int(new_quantity), int(inventory_id), int(user_id), int(item_id)),
            )
    return {"success": True, "stacks": [int(q) for _inventory_id, q in plan if int(q) > 0]}


def buy_alchemist_potion_17_19_3(user_id,item_id,quantity):
    """Atomically purchase an exact quantity at the current canonical price."""
    from db_modules.connection import conn,cursor
    from db_modules.inventory import add_item
    item_id=int(item_id); quantity=int(quantity)
    potion=POTIONS.get(item_id)
    if not potion or item_id not in ALCHEMIST_SHOP: return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Такого зілля немає в Алхіміка."}
    if quantity<1 or quantity>999: return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Кількість має бути від 1 до 999."}
    unit=float(potion["buy_price"]); total=round(unit*quantity,2)
    try:
        cursor.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        row=cursor.execute("SELECT COALESCE(gold,0) FROM users WHERE user_id=?",(int(user_id),)).fetchone()
        gold=float(row[0] or 0) if row else 0.0
        if gold<total: conn.rollback(); return {"success":False,"message":f"❌ Недостатньо золота. Потрібно: {total:.2f}, є: {gold:.2f}."}
        result=add_item(int(user_id),item_id,quantity,commit=False)
        if not result.get("success") or int(result.get("added",0) or 0)!=quantity or int(result.get("lost",0) or 0)!=0:
            conn.rollback(); return {"success":False,"message":result.get("message") or "❌ Зілля не вдалося додати."}
        changed=cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=COALESCE(gold,0)-? WHERE user_id=? AND COALESCE(gold,0)>=?",(total,int(user_id),total)).rowcount
        if changed!=1: conn.rollback(); return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Баланс змінився. Купівлю скасовано."}
        normalize_potion_stacks_17_19_3_5(int(user_id), item_id, cursor)
        conn.commit(); return {"success":True,"message":f"✅ Куплено {potion['name']} ×{quantity} за {total:.2f} золота.","quantity":quantity,"total":total}
    except Exception as e:
        conn.rollback(); return {"success":False,"message":f"❌ Купівлю не завершено: {e}"}

def sell_alchemist_potion_17_19_3(user_id,item_id,quantity):
    """Atomically sell only unreserved potion quantity across multiple stacks."""
    from db_modules.connection import conn,cursor
    item_id=int(item_id); quantity=int(quantity)
    potion=POTIONS.get(item_id)
    if not potion or item_id not in ALCHEMIST_SHOP: return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Це зілля Алхімік не купує."}
    if quantity<1 or quantity>999999: return {"success":False,"message":"❌ Некоректна кількість."}
    try:
        cursor.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        rows=cursor.execute("SELECT id,COALESCE(quantity,0) FROM inventory WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=? ORDER BY id",(int(user_id),item_id)).fetchall()
        available_rows=[]; total_available=0
        for inv_id,stack_qty in rows:
            stack_qty=max(0,int(stack_qty or 0))
            reserved_row=cursor.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM inventory_reservations WHERE inventory_id=?",(int(inv_id),)).fetchone()
            reserved=max(0,int((reserved_row[0] if reserved_row else 0) or 0))
            free=max(0,stack_qty-reserved); available_rows.append((int(inv_id),stack_qty,free)); total_available+=free
        if total_available<quantity:
            conn.rollback(); return {"success":False,"message":f"❌ Доступно для продажу лише {total_available}. Зарезервовані зілля не продаються."}
        remaining=quantity
        for inv_id,stack_qty,free in available_rows:
            take=min(remaining,free)
            if take<=0: continue
            new_qty=stack_qty-take
            if new_qty<=0: cursor.execute("DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",(inv_id,int(user_id)))
            else: cursor.execute("UPDATE inventory SET quantity=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",(new_qty,inv_id,int(user_id)))
            remaining-=take
            if remaining<=0: break
        unit=float(potion["sell_price"]); total=round(unit*quantity,2)
        changed=cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=COALESCE(gold,0)+? WHERE user_id=?",(total,int(user_id))).rowcount
        if changed!=1: raise RuntimeError("Не вдалося зарахувати золото")
        normalize_potion_stacks_17_19_3_5(int(user_id), item_id, cursor)
        conn.commit(); return {"success":True,"message":f"✅ Продано {potion['name']} ×{quantity}. Отримано {total:.2f} золота.","quantity":quantity,"total":total}
    except Exception as e:
        conn.rollback(); return {"success":False,"message":f"❌ Продаж не завершено: {e}"}

from __future__ import annotations

_LOCK=threading.RLock();_CONFIGURED=False

_PATTERNS=(
 re.compile(r"(?i)(bot[_-]?token|telegram[_-]?token|api[_-]?token)(\s*[:=]\s*)([^\s,;]+)"),
 re.compile(r"(?i)(authorization)(\s*[:=]\s*)(?:bearer\s+)?([^\s,;]+)"),
 re.compile(r"(?i)(password|passwd|pwd|secret|private[_-]?key|session[_-]?token|auth[_-]?key)(\s*[:=]\s*)([^\s,;]+)"),
 re.compile(r"(?i)bearer\s+[a-z0-9._~+\-/]+=*"),
)
def redact_log_text(value):
 text=str(value)
 for i,p in enumerate(_PATTERNS):
  if i==3:text=p.sub("Bearer [REDACTED]",text)
  else:text=p.sub(lambda m:f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}[REDACTED]",text)
 return text
class RedactingFormatter(logging.Formatter):
 def format(self,record):return redact_log_text(super().format(record))
class MaxLevel(logging.Filter):
 def __init__(self,n):super().__init__();self.n=n
 def filter(self,r):return r.levelno<=self.n
class SecurityOnly(logging.Filter):
 def filter(self,r):return r.name=="rom.security" or r.name.startswith("rom.security.")
class NonSecurity(logging.Filter):
 def filter(self,r):return not (r.name=="rom.security" or r.name.startswith("rom.security."))

 x=str(os.getenv("ROM_LOG_LEVEL","INFO")).strip().upper();return getattr(logging,x,logging.INFO) if x in {"DEBUG","INFO","WARNING","ERROR","CRITICAL"} else logging.INFO

def configure_production_logging(force=False):
 global _CONFIGURED
 with _LOCK:
  root=logging.getLogger()
  if _CONFIGURED and not force:return logging_status()
  if force:
   for h in list(root.handlers):

  _LOG_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);level=_level();fmt=RedactingFormatter("%(asctime)s.%(msecs)03d | %(levelname)s | %(name)s | %(threadName)s | %(message)s",datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  console=logging.StreamHandler();console.setLevel(level);console.setFormatter(fmt);console.addFilter(NonSecurity())
  app=_handler(_LOG_ROOT/"log"/"rom.log",level,14);app.setFormatter(fmt);app.addFilter(NonSecurity());app.addFilter(MaxLevel(logging.WARNING))
  error=_handler(_LOG_ROOT/"error"/"rom_error.log",logging.ERROR,30);error.setFormatter(fmt);error.addFilter(NonSecurity())
  security=_handler(_LOG_ROOT/"security"/"rom_security.log",logging.INFO,30);security.setFormatter(fmt);security.addFilter(SecurityOnly())
  for h in (console,app,error,security):h._rom_production_handler=True;root.addHandler(h)
  root.setLevel(logging.DEBUG);logging.captureWarnings(True);_CONFIGURED=True
  logging.getLogger("rom.logging").info("production_logging_configured level=%s retention=14/30/30",logging.getLevelName(level));return logging_status()

 return {"configured":_CONFIGURED,"level":logging.getLevelName(_level()),"paths":{"app":str(_LOG_ROOT/"log"/"rom.log"),"error":str(_LOG_ROOT/"error"/"rom_error.log"),"security":str(_LOG_ROOT/"security"/"rom_security.log")},"retention_days":{"app":14,"error":30,"security":30}}

def _has_legacy_user_unique():
    for row in cursor.execute("PRAGMA index_list('pve_encounters')").fetchall():
        name, unique, partial = str(row[1]), int(row[2] or 0), int(row[4] or 0)
        if not unique or partial: continue
        cols=[str(x[2]) for x in cursor.execute(f'PRAGMA index_info("{name}")').fetchall()]
        if cols==['user_id']: return True
    return False

def _migrate_legacy_schema():
    if not _has_legacy_user_unique(): return False
    columns="encounter_id,user_id,chat_id,started_at,deadline_at,status,terminal_reason,terminal_at,mob_snapshot_json,created_at,updated_at"
    conn.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
    try:
        cursor.execute('ALTER TABLE pve_encounters RENAME TO pve_encounters_18_18_1_legacy')
        _create_schema()
        cursor.execute(f'INSERT INTO pve_encounters({columns}) SELECT {columns} FROM pve_encounters_18_18_1_legacy')
        old_count=cursor.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pve_encounters_18_18_1_legacy').fetchone()[0]
        new_count=cursor.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pve_encounters').fetchone()[0]
        if old_count!=new_count: raise RuntimeError('PvE encounter migration row-count mismatch')
        cursor.execute('DROP TABLE pve_encounters_18_18_1_legacy')
        conn.commit(); return True
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback(); raise

def init_pve_auto_escape_system():
    with _LOCK:
        exists=cursor.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='pve_encounters'").fetchone()
        migrated=_migrate_legacy_schema() if exists else False
        if not migrated:
            _create_schema(); conn.commit()
        return {'success':True,'legacy_schema_migrated':migrated}

def get_active_pve_encounter(user_id):

def claim_pve_terminal(user_id, reason, encounter_id=None, now=None, require_expired=False):
    init_pve_auto_escape_system(); now=now or _utcnow(); allowed={'victory','defeat','manual_escape','auto_escape'}
    if reason not in allowed: raise ValueError('invalid PvE terminal reason')
    with _LOCK:
        try: conn.rollback()
        except Exception: pass
        conn.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
        sql="UPDATE pve_encounters SET status=?,terminal_reason=?,terminal_at=?,updated_at=? WHERE user_id=? AND status='active'"; args=[reason,reason,_iso(now),_iso(now),int(user_id)]
        if encounter_id: sql+=' AND encounter_id=?'; args.append(str(encounter_id))
        if require_expired: sql+=' AND deadline_at<=?'; args.append(_iso(now))
        changed=cursor.execute(sql,tuple(args)).rowcount==1
        conn.commit()
    return changed

def get_expired_active_pve_encounters(now=None, limit=100):
    init_pve_auto_escape_system(); now=now or _utcnow(); rows=cursor.execute("SELECT encounter_id,user_id,chat_id,deadline_at FROM pve_encounters WHERE status='active' AND deadline_at<=? ORDER BY deadline_at LIMIT ?",(_iso(now),int(limit))).fetchall()
    return [{'encounter_id':r[0],'user_id':r[1],'chat_id':r[2],'deadline_at':r[3]} for r in rows]

def expire_pve_encounters_once(bot, now=None):
    claimed=[]
    for row in get_expired_active_pve_encounters(now):
        if not claim_pve_terminal(row['user_id'],'auto_escape',row['encounter_id'],now,True): continue
        if hasattr(bot,'user_data'): bot.user_data.pop(row['user_id'],None)
        try: bot.send_message(row['chat_id'],AUTO_ESCAPE_TEXT)
        except Exception as error: print(f"PVE AUTO ESCAPE NOTICE FAILED user={row['user_id']}: {error}")
        claimed.append(row)
    return claimed

def recover_pve_encounters_after_restart(bot, now=None):
    """Expire overdue encounters and restore pending runtime state with the original deadline."""
    init_pve_auto_escape_system(); now=now or _utcnow(); expired=expire_pve_encounters_once(bot,now); expired_ids={x['encounter_id'] for x in expired}; restored=[]
    rows=cursor.execute("SELECT encounter_id,user_id,chat_id,started_at,deadline_at,mob_snapshot_json FROM pve_encounters WHERE status='active' AND deadline_at>?",(_iso(now),)).fetchall()
    if not hasattr(bot,'user_data'): bot.user_data={}
    for eid,uid,cid,started,deadline,payload in rows:
        mob=json.loads(payload or '{}'); mob['pve_encounter_id']=eid; mob['pve_started_at']=started; mob['pve_deadline_at']=deadline
        bot.user_data[int(uid)]=mob; restored.append(int(uid))
    return {'escaped_user_ids':[x['user_id'] for x in expired], 'restored_user_ids':restored, 'expired_encounter_ids':sorted(expired_ids)}

def start_pve_auto_escape_worker(bot):
    global _WORKER_STARTED
    init_pve_auto_escape_system()
    if _WORKER_STARTED:return False
    _WORKER_STARTED=True
    def loop():
        while True:
            try: expire_pve_encounters_once(bot)
            except Exception as error: print(f'PVE AUTO ESCAPE WORKER ERROR: {error}')
            time.sleep(PVE_AUTO_ESCAPE_SWEEP_SECONDS)
    threading.Thread(target=loop,name='pve-auto-escape',daemon=True).start(); return True

# ROM 17.16.1 PVE SKILL BUTTON STATES
"""Pure, mutation-free PvE skill availability and button-state resolver."""
from __future__ import annotations


def _turns_uk(value):
    value = max(0, int(value or 0))
    mod_10 = value % 10
    mod_100 = value % 100
    if mod_10 == 1 and mod_100 != 11:
        word = "хід"
    elif mod_10 in (2, 3, 4) and mod_100 not in (12, 13, 14):
        word = "ходи"
    else:
        word = "ходів"
    return f"{value} {word}"


def _state(skill, available, reason, label, message, **extra):
    key = str(skill.get("key") or "")
    result = {
        "available": bool(available),
        "reason": str(reason),
        "label": str(label),
        "message": str(message),
        "callback_data": (
            f"combat_use_skill:{key}"
            if available
            else f"skill_locked:{key}:{reason}"
        ),
    }
    result.update(extra)
    return result


def get_pve_skill_action_state(user_id, mob, skill):
    """Return current PvE skill UI state without mutating DB or combat state."""
    del user_id
    mob = mob or {}
    skill = skill or {}
    name = str(skill.get("name") or skill.get("key") or "Навичка")
    key = str(skill.get("key") or "")

    cooldowns = mob.get("skill_cooldowns") or {}
    cooldown = max(0, int(cooldowns.get(key, 0) or 0))
    if cooldown > 0:
        return _state(
            skill, False, "cooldown",
            f"⏳ {name} · ще {_turns_uk(cooldown)}",
            f"⏳ {name} ще перезаряджається. Залишилось: {_turns_uk(cooldown)}.",
            remaining=cooldown,
        )

    player_stunned = max(0, int(mob.get("player_stunned_turns", 0) or 0))
    player_effects = mob.get("player_effects") or {}
    controlled = player_stunned > 0 or any(
        str(effect.get("type") or "").lower() in {"stun", "silence", "control"}
        and int(effect.get("turns", 0) or 0) > 0
        for effect in player_effects.values()
        if isinstance(effect, dict)
    )
    if controlled:
        return _state(
            skill, False, "control_state",
            f"🔒 {name} · зараз недоступна",
            f"🔒 {name} зараз недоступна через ефект контролю.",
        )

    cost_type = str(skill.get("cost_type") or "")
    cost = max(0, int(skill.get("cost", 0) or 0))

    if cost_type == "rage":
        current = max(0, int(mob.get("player_rage", 0) or 0))
        if current < cost:
            return _state(skill, False, "not_enough_rage",
                          f"🔒 {name} · потрібно {cost} Люті",
                          f"🔴 Недостатньо Люті для {name}. Потрібно: {cost}, доступно: {current}.",
                          required=cost, available_amount=current)

    elif cost_type == "rage_all_min":
        required = max(0, int(skill.get("min_cost", 30) or 30))
        current = max(0, int(mob.get("player_rage", 0) or 0))
        if current < required:
            return _state(skill, False, "not_enough_rage",
                          f"🔒 {name} · потрібно {required} Люті",
                          f"🔴 Недостатньо Люті для {name}. Потрібно мінімум: {required}, доступно: {current}.",
                          required=required, available_amount=current)

    elif cost_type in {"combat_energy", "combat_energy_combo"}:
        current = max(0, int(mob.get("player_combat_energy", 0) or 0))
        maximum = max(0, int(mob.get("player_max_combat_energy", 100) or 100))
        projected = min(maximum, current + 20)
        if projected < cost:
            return _state(skill, False, "not_enough_combat_energy",
                          f"🔒 {name} · потрібно {cost} Енергії",
                          f"🟡 Недостатньо Енергії для {name}. Потрібно: {cost}, на початку ходу буде доступно: {projected}.",
                          required=cost, available_amount=projected)
        if cost_type == "combat_energy_combo":
            required_combo = max(1, int(skill.get("min_combo", 1) or 1))
            combo = max(0, int(mob.get("player_combo_points", 0) or 0))
            if combo < required_combo:
                return _state(skill, False, "not_enough_combo",
                              f"🔒 {name} · потрібно {required_combo} комбо",
                              f"⚔️ Недостатньо комбо для {name}. Потрібно: {required_combo}, доступно: {combo}.",
                              required=required_combo, available_amount=combo)

    elif cost_type == "mana":
        current = max(0, int(mob.get("player_mp", 0) or 0))
        if current < cost:
            return _state(skill, False, "not_enough_mana",
                          f"🔒 {name} · потрібно {cost} Мани",
                          f"🔵 Недостатньо Мани для {name}. Потрібно: {cost}, доступно: {current}.",
                          required=cost, available_amount=current)

    return _state(skill, True, "ok", f"✨ {name}", "")

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Mapping

from systems.pvp_config import PVP_COMBAT_ENERGY_MAX
from systems.pvp_skill_adapter import get_production_pvp_skill, load_production_pvp_skill_catalog


def projected_round_cooldown(participant: Mapping[str, Any], skill_key: str) -> int:
    """Cooldown visible to the action validator after the engine start-of-round tick."""
    stored = int(dict(participant.get("cooldowns") or {}).get(str(skill_key), 0) or 0)
    return max(0, stored - 1)


def projected_round_resource(participant: Mapping[str, Any]) -> int:
    value = int(participant.get("resource_value", participant.get("resource", 0)) or 0)
    if str(participant.get("resource_type") or "") in {"combat_energy", "combat_energy_combo"}:
        return min(PVP_COMBAT_ENERGY_MAX, value + 20)
    return value


def validate_pvp_action_choice(
    participant: Mapping[str, Any],
    action_type: str,
    skill_key: str | None = None,
    *,
    catalog: Mapping[str, tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Prevalidate a UI action without mutating state or consuming the round.

    The pure round engine remains the final authority. This helper mirrors the
    engine's imminent start-of-round cooldown tick and Combat Energy regeneration
    so a choice accepted by the UI is not rejected later for stale resource data.
    """
    action_type = str(action_type or "")
    if action_type == "basic_attack":
        return {"success": True, "reason": "ok", "message": ""}
    if action_type != "skill" or not skill_key:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "invalid_action", "message": "❌ Невідома бойова дія. Оберіть іншу дію."}

    class_key = str(participant.get("class_key") or "")
    skill = get_production_pvp_skill(class_key, str(skill_key), catalog or load_production_pvp_skill_catalog())
    if not skill:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "unknown_skill", "message": "❌ Ця навичка не належить вашому класу. Оберіть іншу дію."}

    name = str(skill.get("name") or skill_key)
    cooldown = projected_round_cooldown(participant, str(skill_key))
    if cooldown > 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "reason": "skill_on_cooldown",
            "remaining": cooldown,
            "message": f"⏳ «{name}» ще відновлюється. Залишилося раундів: {cooldown}. Оберіть іншу дію.",
        }

    cost_type = str(skill.get("cost_type") or "")
    cost = max(0, int(skill.get("cost") or 0))
    resource = projected_round_resource(participant)
    mp = int(participant.get("mp") or 0)
    combo = int(participant.get("combo") or 0)

    if cost_type == "mana" and mp < cost:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "not_enough_mana", "required": cost, "available": mp, "message": f"🔷 Недостатньо мани для «{name}». Потрібно: {cost} MP, доступно: {mp} MP. Оберіть іншу дію."}
    if cost_type == "rage" and resource < cost:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "not_enough_rage", "required": cost, "available": resource, "message": f"🔥 Недостатньо Люті для «{name}». Потрібно: {cost}, доступно: {resource}. Оберіть іншу дію."}
    if cost_type == "rage_all_min":
        minimum = max(0, int(skill.get("min_cost") or 0))
        if resource < minimum:
            return {"success": False, "reason": "not_enough_rage", "required": minimum, "available": resource, "message": f"🔥 Недостатньо Люті для «{name}». Потрібно щонайменше: {minimum}, доступно: {resource}. Оберіть іншу дію."}
    if cost_type in {"combat_energy", "combat_energy_combo"} and resource < cost:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "not_enough_combat_energy", "required": cost, "available": resource, "message": f"⚡ Недостатньо Енергії для «{name}». Потрібно: {cost}, після відновлення доступно: {resource}. Оберіть іншу дію."}
    if cost_type == "combat_energy_combo":
        minimum_combo = int(skill.get("min_combo") or 1)
        if combo < minimum_combo:
            return {"success": False, "reason": "not_enough_combo", "required": minimum_combo, "available": combo, "message": f"🔗 Недостатньо комбо для «{name}». Потрібно: {minimum_combo}, доступно: {combo}. Оберіть іншу дію."}

    return {
        "success": True,
        "reason": "ok",
        "message": "",
        "skill": dict(skill),
        "projected_resource": resource,
        "projected_cooldown": cooldown,
    }


def pvp_skill_button_state(participant: Mapping[str, Any], skill: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result = validate_pvp_action_choice(participant, "skill", str(skill.get("key") or ""), catalog={str(participant.get("class_key") or ""): (dict(skill),)})
    name = str(skill.get("name") or skill.get("key") or "Навичка")
    if result.get("success"):
        return {"available": True, "label": f"✨ {name}", "reason": "ok"}
    if result.get("reason") == "skill_on_cooldown":
        return {"available": False, "label": f"⏳ {name} · {int(result.get('remaining') or 0)}", "reason": result.get("reason")}
    return {"available": False, "label": f"🔒 {name}", "reason": result.get("reason")}
